Very good phone for this prize range, no complaints. Of-course it lags when multiple downloads or apps updating, while multi-tasking( mid-heavy). So this phone is for low usage users obviously not for heavy gaming (light gaming okay). Very good bright screen. Camera is decent then again one must consider the price. I  both this for a lady relative. Doesn't use it for gaming or heavy usage, but still can brag about this big screen good quality screen. So all this is said with he price in mind, so be realistic with your expectations. If this were costlier (5k & above) it would be a worthless & you can be unhappy. But the build quality must be appreciated, even costlier phone costing 10k wouldn't have such a great build. So great screen & build quality FOR THIS PRICE?  well worth it.

column3: Micromax Superfone Lite A75 (Charcoal Black, 190 MB)
column7:
Lo and behold! Samsung has found its greatest rival in India. And no, it is not Apple. It is called: MMX.
  

  The Micromax (MMX) A75 is an amazing phone for its price range.
  

  You can easily get it for ~8k in the open market (as I did), though I feel it should be 1k cheaper to hit the sweet spot within the budget Android smartphone marketspace.
  

  Pros:
  
  * Excellent display (not an IPS or LED), with ambient light sensor. Screen is large yet comfortable in the hands, and the colors are rich with good viewing angles. Brightnees is perfect to use the phone even in broad daylight, and easily adjustable, so night-time reading is comfortable too.
  
  * Battery is actually quite decent and will last you a through more than half a day of medium surfing and gaming, and those who are complaining about it, haven't calibrated their phone's battery properly.
  
  * Stock OS is 2.3.4, but Micromax have tweaked it magnificiently. In particular, the lockscreen is unique and the notification pulldown has a nice extra pane called Toolkits, which has widgets for all the common shortcuts you would need (including GPS/WiFi/Bluetooth, AirplaneMode, AutoBrightness, Reboot/PowerOff, etc., and most importantly, Data Connection!).
  
  * There's an inbuilt app called "Fire Wall", that allows you to blacklist/whitelist incoming phone calls and SMS's -- completely free! I haven't really experimented with it much (since it has to be kept running in the background for it to work properly), but it is good to see Micromax trying to set itself apart from the competition with such thoughtful ideas.
  
  * There's even a theme manager with some fantastic themes!
  
  * Camera is 3MP, with a single LED for flash, and its quality is good enough for my purposes.
  

  Cons:
  
  * Processor is older generation, but its performance can be called decent (for a 650Mhz one; perhaps it is overclocked?). Live wallpapers and UI don't have any noticeable lag, except when doing a lot of multitasking.
  
  * You have to touch the power button on top, to wake up the display when it goes to standby/sleep. I would suggest changing the display standby time from 30 seconds to 1 min, and as a habit, lock the screen before you tuck the phone away.
  
  * Sound quality of the speakers is average -- bass is weak. So most of the ringtones will sound slightly tinny. On a headphone, sound quality is quite good, and a "Bass Boost" option on the default Music Player app is useful.
  
  * Power port is placed on the left side of the casing, while  ideally it should be at the top or bottom, and should be covered with a sliding flap.
  
  * Removing the battery panel and even the battery is a very tricky affair! The back panel of the phone is very smooth and can be slippery in sweaty hands, though the device still fits snugly into the palm.
  
  * Internal RAM is 512MB, of which ~230MB is occupied by system apps.
  
  * I found some preloaded apps, such as Facebook, Saavn, TOI, Quickr, Google Maps, Local, Navigation, Latitude, etc. (and only one junk app called Ibibo Teenpatti), and there's no way to remove them (unless you are willing to void the warranty, by trying to root the phone -- which is not for the faint of heart, as there's not much of a modding community for the A75 as yet). Thankfully, even with all these preloaded apps, there's still 270MB of internal memory free for our use, and we have the option of expandable memory (upto 32GB microSD card).
  
  * Micromax have tried a meagre attempt to create their own app store, but it is best you avoid it as it doesn't work most of the time and you are better off sampling all the goodies at the Google Play (Market) appstore instead.
  

  All in all, this is about as good a smartphone as you can expect for this budget, and all its niggles do not outweigh its fantastic features.

column6: Fairly Good sub 10k Dual SIM with GPS
column7:
I've been using this phone for about 3 weeks now. I was specifically looking for a dual-SIM phone with GPS.
  

  It took me while to get used to the Android Interface and Keyboard. I was using a Samsung B5722 before this.
  

  I got used to the phone fairly quickly without referring to the manual provided. The manual is pretty minimal; talks about the basic features only.
  

  The touch screen is clear, bright and responsive. Though you can set the screen brightness to "Auto," it is still a struggle to see the screen in bright sunlight.
  

  The phone allows multiple screens and each screen can be viewed by swiping.
  

  Call volume is good with an physical button to control volume. The supplied earphones are comfortable to wear, with good volume.
  

  The basic SIM connectivity is not good. There are times, when the phone is in the pouch, the SIM cards disconnect, and I have to enter the SIM unlock pin numbers for the SIM to re-initialize (like when the phone is re-booting or being switched on)!
  

  Bluetooth connectivity is good, and it is relatively easy to pair devices.
  

  GPS connectivity is a problem. I still haven't been able to use the built in Google Maps properly. Even the Compass app does not work well unless the phone is out in the open and held upright! A-GPS is available, but that assumes you have either GPRS or 3G or WiFi on and connected. It's easy to connect to a WiFi hotspot. Interestingly, this phone itself can be configured as a WiFi hotspot itself, but without any security settings!
  

  The battery is 1300 AH battery, and lasts for a day. You can view battery usage; you'll notice that the phones biggest drain is the Standby function! Some Android apps like Facebook, TOI are automatically started and will also drain the battery. Carefully removing unwanted apps can lead to better battery life.

column6: Don't get deceived by it's low price. It's amazing.
column7:
Pros:
  
  Its a charm to use this set in everyday routine especially because of first 3 reasons:
  
  Awesome display with extremely rich and true colors.
  
  Ultra smooth touch.(Just loved this).
  
  No hanging or lagging issue despite heavy usage(but I have used it only for 20 days till now).
  
  Very good camera with rich and true colors. Though it can't be compared to iphone but camera better than the sets in 15k segments.
  
  Supports VR due to gyroscope. Works like a charm.
  
  Selfie camera is very good but not compared to my mother's OPPO 16MP front camera.
  
  No botheration of charging everyday. (4000mAH).
  
  Strength: Due to poor grip back cover that comes free with this phone, my phone fell drastically. No clue of scratch or breakage. Thank god!
  
  Good looks and a charm to hold
  

  Cons:
  
  Only one color available. I love black and didn't find that color. Mobile looks great but I miss black.
  
  Back cover that comes with the phone is has a very poor grip. Don't use it if like me, you generally keep mobile in hands rather than pocket. I purchased a back cover separately which is fine.
  
  Some heating problem if we use it heavily while being charged.
  
  The screen guard that comes along leaves a very thin space on the sides open. The screen guard should have been broader by 0.5mm. Not a big issue though.
  
  I didn't like the gallery as it has some good and useful functions but I like it really simple. So I installed a gallery app separately and it works just perfect for me.
  

  Conclusive experience: It's a charm to use this mobile everyday. This is the best phone in my huge family except my brother's S7 edge(waterproof) and my cousin's Iphone7. Much better than my mother's OppoA57 except for it's selfie camera.
  
  Conclusive suggestion: If you are looking for a reliable and fun to use phone under 20K this is the best one. But if you are specifically looking for highly specialized selfie oriented camera then there are other options available at even 14-15K.
  

  This should have been priced at at-least 15K. Because while searching phones with my requirements, I ignored it several times due to extremely low price. I have used Micromax Nitro for 3 years without any lag or issue. So I have faith in Micromax.

  The display used is AMOLED  is really impressive with pproper colour resolution, viewing angel and superb contrast, same as Samsung's AMOLED display.

  I wish the processor was the latest one as Micromax had already switched to premium handset version.
  
  The battery on both devices are almost the same supporting fast charging (Quick Charge) capability, so do not worry this device will last the entire day on moderate usage. The price difference is almost 5000 but both device are unique in their specified terms.
  
  Whereas  considering the dual camera and the Beauty mode on the Micromax dual 5 I would surely suggest to go with Micromax Dual 5 as they are providing better camera functionality as well as better image processing compared to oneplus 3.

column6: Decent phone given the price range and also review for Flipkart service.
column7:
Micromax Canvas 2 Colors A120 with 8 GB ROM(Grey)
  

  Seller : WS Retail
  
  Price : 7799
  

  So my kid brother wanted this phone and the price was Rs.8500+. But i saw it go down to Rs.7799 on 19th of November and booked it. I strongly recommend everyone to see if the seller is covered by the 'Flipkart Advantage' badge, as it provides a 30 day replacement policy.
  
  The estimated date of arrival was 24th but got it by 23rd(Sunday).
  
  Was well packed and sealed. The contents were precise, as described in the description.
  
  I opened the package the very same day carefully without simply just tearing it off as many do. Because just in case you have to return the product,  they ask you to include everything from the package you've received including price tags, labels, original packing, freebies and accessories.
  
  The first thing i did and i suggest everyone else to do is check for defects and damage.  Though Flipkart is very much trustworthy, it's better to be safe than sorry. Especially with electronics as it can have some manufacture defects.
  
  I checked the charger, headset and back covers. Then i checked the phone. And i found that the left side of the touch screen was unresponsive. I tried switching the phone on and off and did a hard reset but it didn't work. I switched off the phone, removed the battery and put all the contents in the box, the way it was.
  
  After my product status was updated to  delivered  and i received my email invoice, I contacted Flipkart via their email option provided in the customer support page.
  
  Please note that they can help only after you have received your invoices.
  
  I got a reply to my email in mere 5 minutes stating that they would get back to me in 3 business days to resolve my issue.
  
  Got a call from their executives on 25th.  I explained them about the defect in the product and the troubleshooting methods i used. Unfortunately, they said that the item was out of stock from WS Retail and there would be no replacement. I would get my money refunded.  I told them that i will get back to them after deciding.
  
  The very next day on 26th , i saw that the product was back in stock and i immediately contacted the customer executives. They told me that they would get back to me by 28th. But they contacted me on 26th evening itself and said they would replace my product.
  
  Got a replacement on 30th  along with an acknowledgement slip, after the old product was verified and fortunately this time without any defect.
  

  Coming to the phone (finally), it looks decent. The front end camera is okay-ish. The rear end camera is good. No problems with that.
  
  The main drawback is the limited space for apps. If you are an app junkie and install lots of apps, skip this phone.
  
  The phone came preloaded with Kit-Kat version which doesn't have smart gestures. Jellybean does.
  
  Battery back up is normal. Heavy usage drains the battery fast and heats up the phone a bit. But i guess any other phone does too.
  
  Internet speed using 3g and wifi are pretty fast.
  

  Wanna buy a phone under 10k?  Certainly keep this one on your list but there are other phones out there too. And in a few months many more will come up as well.
  

  RATING: 3 1/2 STARS.

Writing this review after using it for about a month.So going to be really honest about each and everything.Trying to provide all the pros and cons about this phone.
  

  Pros- Fast, vanilla stock android Kitkat.Its actually smooth as you can imagine it too be.The jellybean version of the phone was tinkered with some customization but with the kitkat update rolling out i guess they dint have any time for any time for customization.Hence it resulted in a few bugs as well.(Explained in cons)
  

  Good camera.It has a very good camera which is really clear and takes quite good pictures both indoors and outdoors and trust me when i say this,i have used many phones and this camera is very different from the rest.its actually better.Have tested images of nexus 4,Samsung galaxy grand 2,Nokia Lumia's and blaah blaah but this camera is seriously good.The front camera is good for selfies and has decent clarity.Flash is quite powerful but does not make your subject too flashy which is a good thing.
  

  Tried heavy games like Gta San andreas,Modern combat 4 and real boxing and all have played absolutely flawlessly so you will not have any problems running any games i guess.
  

  Very nice vibrant display.Again one of the best displays i have come across.Thanks to the ips technology.Watching a movie is a treat. :)
  

  Nice build quality.The added back covers is a plus but please use a decent back cover because the phone covers tend to get dirty and i havent tried cleaning it. :D
  

  Now about the Cons
  
  When you are buying phones from a company like micromax understand that these phones are just rebranded so the dream of an android upgrade is just a dream.It will never become a reality.(i guess no lollipop for this because its already upgraded to kitkat once :P).If your phone has some bugs then the chances of a software upgrade are almost negligible.The company has not evolved that much to handle such a trivial situation.
  

  Heat issues-Well the heat issue is quite normal nowadays.Earlier i was really worried about it but now it seems not to be a tension for me.Yes the phones heats up a lot when you play heavy games so i would advice you to give short breaks when you are playing it or use a fan when you are playing one.Cheap yet effective.The heat can actually be felt on your palm but you will notice that it subsides after a few days and then is constant.The temperature range is about 39-41 degrees when you play a game for about 20 mins.So i would advise heavy gamers to avoid this.
  

  Decent music quality-The phone has got a decent music quality.The headphones you get are average but i would suggest you to get a good pair but you have to test and buy it because i have seen a weird thing in micromax phones where the headphones are not able to give their potential output.Maybe its a problem with the 3.5 mm headphone jack which is made in this way!
  

  The phone has got a decent battery output as well-Earlier the battery used to drain quite easily but now i get a better battery backup.The phone will last you a day and a half with above average use with a single sim in.(come on its android!) havent tried the idea of buying a 3000 mah battery so i have a powerbank for emergencies which is going quite well for me.
  

  Micromax is not a company where you get high resale value so if you regret your decision later on the price you get even if you use it for like 10 days will be half :(
  
  conclusion- If you are looking to buy a  phone which you will use for a year then go for it.Its cheap and yes it will beat all the phones even falling under a 18000 price range like samsung :P
  

  Avoid it if you are a heavy gamer.!
  

  Otherwise go for it ! :) Its a steal :)
  

  Design-7/10
  

  Perfomance-8/10
  

  Gaming-8/10
  

  Camera-8/10
  

  Display-9/10
  

  Battery-7/10

column6: Low Internal Memory Problem Solved. (Compleate Product Review)
column7:
First I shall mention about low internal
  
  The phone have .89 gb internal app memory and 5.28 Gb internal sd card. Internal sd can be used for mass storage, it can not store installed apps. User initially gets 650 Mb free app storage ( rest is filled with uninstable system app and some useless pre installed apps installed by micromax which can not be uninstalled).
  
  Even you move a app to external sd (installed app can not be moved in internal 5.28 Gb sd) about 15-20 mb will remain in the app storage.
  
  Some apps even can not be moved to external sd( example facebook app eats about 90 mb of .89 gb app storage).
  
  Apps can not be installed when there is less than 130 Mb in the internal .89gb storage.
  
  Normally You can at most install 30 apps.
  
  I have solved this problen. To solve this you have to root this phone.
  
  The phone can not be rooted with framaroot apk.
  
  I rooted my phone with kingroot apk. (Do not mis confuse with kingoroot)
  
  kingroot is a chinese app but after rooting kinguser is installed in english. (google search about kingroot if you have doubt).
  
  After rooting you have to partition your external sd card using minitool partition wizard (pc softwere). Partitioning will wipe all sd card dada make a bacckup in pc before doing partition.
  
  Then download link2sd from google play store in your rooted phone.
  
  This app links (moves) all part of the app to the second partition of external sd card.
  
  google serarch about it (flipkart does not allow provide link in review)
  
  If you have any doubt google search about link2sd.
  
  After rooting never try to remove any system app using lik2sd or any othet root apps.
  
  After linking your internal memory do not open your sd card form your phone. If you need to remove the sd card first remove all the link using link2sd.
  
  Otherwise you will face trouble. To solve this trouble I had to factory reset my phone and repartion sd card using minitool partition wizard.
  
  link2sd plus (paid version of link2sd) is much more better than link2sd. I am using link2sd plus.
  
  Using link2sd you shall be able to keep about 90 apps. Link2sd plus have no limitition, apps storage will be only be linitted by your sd storage.
  
  Rooting will end your phones warranty.
  
  Before rooting first make sure that you do not have any hardwere problem.
  
  If you find any hardwere problem after rooting you have to flash the stock kitkat ROM Using sp flash tools. Then you will get back your wareanty. (Flashing Stock ROM solves any kind of softwere problem). Do not flash rom just for experiment purpose unless you really need.
  
  I am not responsible if anything wrong happens to you following this prcedure. Proceed at your own risk.
  
  The batrery Life Of this phone is really poor.
  
  It can not play video more than 4 hours with full screen brightness.
  
  You can not play games even for 3 hours with full charge battery.
  
  The phone does not support 32gb sd card as sd card. I purched samsung 32gb evo class 10 memory card. When i stored data more than 18 Gb entire phone started hanging. The phone could not be even shudded down. Turning out the battery was only way. ( I faced this problem before using link2sd. If you have any problem with your sd card, do not use link2sd with that sd).
  
  Now I am using a 16gb samsung nemory card with no problem.
  
  This phone supports OTG I am using the 32 Gb memory card in a card reader as usb storage in this phone for backups. The phones supports 32gb usb storage with no problem.

I bought this phone about a month ago by a local retailer in Mumbai and have been using it ever since. Here are the pros and cons properly listed because I have OCD:
  

  1. The Screen- The 5 incher with a high resolution makes everything a joy to look at. The colour reproduction is really good and so are the viewing angles. Full marks there.
  
  2. the looks- it doesn't look like other mmx devices and that's a good thing, I'm telling you. People saw my phone and they were really impressed. It comes with changable back covers and the one in white looks premium.
  
  3. Processing power- The specs on paper really do work in real life ensuring a seamless and lag free performance. I don't play any heavy games, but i run a lot of apps simultaneously and they work great.
  
  4. Camera- The 8 MP is no Xperia or Lumia, but it is a above avg camera at this price range. The photos were really good outdoors and decent enough in low lights. I'm guessing you're no professional photographer like me, and this camera will be more than enough for you.
  

  Now, the Cons:
  
  1. Insufficient battery- this can be a major flaw. The battery provided is NOT sufficient for this phone to last a whole day. You will need to charge it if you are a heavy user. Battery drains quickly in 3G standby (in around 6 hours) which is really upsetting. And this was when I was using only one sim!   Secondly, this phone is pretty awesome. With 6 days usage I would like to point out....
  
  - Camera quality is redefined by MMX in this product. Awesome Rear Camera and Front  Camera has too clear and sharp images (give more than it said ~ 2MP).
  
  - Improvement in sound quality by MMX.
  
  - No Lags.

  - It supports 20 regional languages via inbuilt Reverie Smartpad (though MMX didn't advertise it anywhere).
  
  -Both SIMS support 3G.
  
  - Believe me you can't get all this in any other brand at this price segment of 8.5k - 9k.
  
  ________________________________________________________________________
  
  Nothing is believed to be perfect in this world; even this device too.
  
  - Poor battery backup (It's true). If you are an average user of phone,as me,your juice can last upto 12-15 hours for normal use. But believe me you have to charge it twice a day (may be during night and evening).
  
  2 Hours of game play sips 50% of battery juice!!!! It's HD IPS display and quad-core processor sips a lot of Sweet Juice while surfing the web. Even battery drops by 1% while using camera for 5 minutes.
  
  - Poor RAM optimisation: This device comes with 1 GB of RAM. For first 2 days, I didn't install any app, nor did I use internet. I Just use it as a phone without anything (just camera, settings and other inbuilt apps) and alas, I was left with only 200 MB free  RAM.
  
  But no problem. Just remove the apps from multi-tasking window and reboot your device. You will get 500 MB free RAM again.
  
  - Music Player has some gliches, but we can download other music players.
  
  - Many reviewed that this device heats a lot. I was also worried about this HOTness before buying it. But believe me it is not as much HOT (so far) as they reviewed :D . It only heats up while playing games for long time but not too much while normal use and surfing (Warm up).  Happy for that. I would advice to use light coloured back panels (phone looks decent).

column6: Canvas2 Colours - at the price of S-Duos2, get specifications of Grand2 !!!!
column7:
I purchased this sturdy performer from Micromax for Rs. 9,700 from a local shop. I will not list its specifications which everyone knows (i.e. 1.3Ghz Quad Core, 1GB RAM etc.) I am here to tell you apart from decent specifications and a very good looking and sturdy phone, what you get EXTRA with this Canvas:
  

  1) Both SIM supports 3G. This feature is not listed anywhere. I only came to know about this after purchasing and using this phone.
  
  2) USB OTG support. Again this feature is neither listed on flipkart nor anywhere else.
  
  3) Notification Light (inside the earpiece grill). It glows red or green depending upon the type of notification.
  
  4) Awesome camera performance. MMX phones are known for their poor cameras. But Canvas Colours is an exception. In day light, it captures brilliant images with its 8MP sensor. Images captured renders accurate colours and sharpness. Low light performance of camera and flash is also way better than any other Canvas series phone. Its flash really works in dark, just like Samsung phones. Front camera (2MP) also captures clear and bright images. Two thumbs up for MMX to improve their camera quality.
  
  5) Gesture Controls. This phone supports Gesture Controls like - Proximity Answer Phone, Proximity Dial Phone, Proximity Unlock, Flip to Silent, Flip to turn Speaker Phone on etc. All these gesture controls uses its Proximity Sensor and this sensor works like a charm. In my last Canvas Phone, even after removing the phone from my ears, it takes 2-3 seconds to light up the screen but not in case of this phone. Proximity Sensor works in a fraction of seconds.
  
  6) Great UI customization. MMX has customised Android 4.2.2 in a great way. The user interface looks neat and fresh with new icons and colour backgrounds. Notification Bar, Dialer, Widgets, In-Call screen graphics, Menu animations and Icons are the main customized areas. This phone has got i-phone like rectangular icons, which look great.
  
  7) Excellent Call Quality. MMX is also known for poor call quality. All the MMX phones I used, had low volume in the earpiece due to which talking in a crowded place or public transport becomes painful. But this problem is thing of the past with this phone. You can hear crystal clear sound of the person on the other line even when you put the phone away from your ears.
  
  7) Gamers Delight. I have played Temple Run 2, Temple Run Oz and Subway Surfers on my phone. These all ran without any lag. Graphics were super sharp. I viewed some reviews on Youtube, in which NFS - Most Wanted, Asphalt, Dead Trigger etc also ran smoothly.
  
  8) Good Viewing Angles. 720p HD IPS display is super sharp and super bright and it provide better viewing angles also.
  
  9) and of course TWO Free Yellow and Aqua Blue along with Black Back Panel. The free back panels are also like original quality. You cant differentiate between the original Black and extra Yellow and Blue Panels in terms of build Quality.
  

  As you know, nothing in this world is perfect, this phone has also some drawbacks:
  
  1) Poor Battery Life. Since it has Quad Core Processor and HD Display, both these feature consumes more power. Its 2000mah battery is inadequate to power this phone for the whole day. Battery percentage drops 1% in every 2-3 minutes while using this phone for surfing net or playing games.
  
  2) Heating Problem. Its back gets heated while charging, playing games, surfing net or while in a call. Sometimes this heat is unbearable in the hand. I hope the Delhi incident dont get repeated with this phone in which a Canvas 2.2 (A114) bursted while in charging.
  
  3) Low usable RAM. Despite having 1GB RAM, due to heavy customization of UI, this phone has less usable RAM. Out of 968 MB of RAM, anytime 550-600 MB gets used by its internal applications.

  Canvas Colours A120 is the ultimate choice if you are having a tight budget of around 9.5K. In this price range, there is not even a single competitor of this phone in any brand. column6: Decent phone given the price range and also review for Flipkart service.
column7:
Micromax Canvas 2 Colors A120 with 8 GB ROM(Grey)
  

  Seller : WS Retail
  
  Price : 7799
  

  So my kid brother wanted this phone and the price was Rs.8500+. But i saw it go down to Rs.7799 on 19th of November and booked it. I strongly recommend everyone to see if the seller is covered by the 'Flipkart Advantage' badge, as it provides a 30 day replacement policy.
  
  The estimated date of arrival was 24th but got it by 23rd(Sunday).
  
  Was well packed and sealed. The contents were precise, as described in the description.
  
  I opened the package the very same day carefully without simply just tearing it off as many do. Because just in case you have to return the product,  they ask you to include everything from the package you've received including price tags, labels, original packing, freebies and accessories.
  
  The first thing i did and i suggest everyone else to do is check for defects and damage.  Though Flipkart is very much trustworthy, it's better to be safe than sorry. Especially with electronics as it can have some manufacture defects.
  
  I checked the charger, headset and back covers. Then i checked the phone. And i found that the left side of the touch screen was unresponsive. I tried switching the phone on and off and did a hard reset but it didn't work. I switched off the phone, removed the battery and put all the contents in the box, the way it was.
  
  After my product status was updated to  delivered  and i received my email invoice, I contacted Flipkart via their email option provided in the customer support page.
  
  Please note that they can help only after you have received your invoices.
  
  I got a reply to my email in mere 5 minutes stating that they would get back to me in 3 business days to resolve my issue.
  
  Got a call from their executives on 25th.  I explained them about the defect in the product and the troubleshooting methods i used. Unfortunately, they said that the item was out of stock from WS Retail and there would be no replacement. I would get my money refunded.  I told them that i will get back to them after deciding.
  
  The very next day on 26th , i saw that the product was back in stock and i immediately contacted the customer executives. They told me that they would get back to me by 28th. But they contacted me on 26th evening itself and said they would replace my product.
  
  Got a replacement on 30th  along with an acknowledgement slip, after the old product was verified and fortunately this time without any defect.
  

  Coming to the phone (finally), it looks decent. The front end camera is okay-ish. The rear end camera is good. No problems with that.
  
  The main drawback is the limited space for apps. If you are an app junkie and install lots of apps, skip this phone.
  
  The phone came preloaded with Kit-Kat version which doesn't have smart gestures. Jellybean does.
  
  Battery back up is normal. Heavy usage drains the battery fast and heats up the phone a bit. But i guess any other phone does too.
  
  Internet speed using 3g and wifi are pretty fast.
  

  Wanna buy a phone under 10k?  Certainly keep this one on your list but there are other phones out there too. And in a few months many more will come up as well.
  

  RATING: 3 1/2 STARS.

Writing this review after using it for about a month.So going to be really honest about each and everything.Trying to provide all the pros and cons about this phone.
  

  Pros- Fast, vanilla stock android Kitkat.Its actually smooth as you can imagine it too be.The jellybean version of the phone was tinkered with some customization but with the kitkat update rolling out i guess they dint have any time for any time for customization.Hence it resulted in a few bugs as well.(Explained in cons)
  

  Good camera.It has a very good camera which is really clear and takes quite good pictures both indoors and outdoors and trust me when i say this,i have used many phones and this camera is very different from the rest.its actually better.Have tested images of nexus 4,Samsung galaxy grand 2,Nokia Lumia's and blaah blaah but this camera is seriously good.The front camera is good for selfies and has decent clarity.Flash is quite powerful but does not make your subject too flashy which is a good thing.
  

  Tried heavy games like Gta San andreas,Modern combat 4 and real boxing and all have played absolutely flawlessly so you will not have any problems running any games i guess.
  

  Very nice vibrant display.Again one of the best displays i have come across.Thanks to the ips technology.Watching a movie is a treat. :)
  

  Nice build quality.The added back covers is a plus but please use a decent back cover because the phone covers tend to get dirty and i havent tried cleaning it. :D
  

  Now about the Cons
  
  When you are buying phones from a company like micromax understand that these phones are just rebranded so the dream of an android upgrade is just a dream.It will never become a reality.(i guess no lollipop for this because its already upgraded to kitkat once :P).If your phone has some bugs then the chances of a software upgrade are almost negligible.The company has not evolved that much to handle such a trivial situation.
  

  Heat issues-Well the heat issue is quite normal nowadays.Earlier i was really worried about it but now it seems not to be a tension for me.Yes the phones heats up a lot when you play heavy games so i would advice you to give short breaks when you are playing it or use a fan when you are playing one.Cheap yet effective.The heat can actually be felt on your palm but you will notice that it subsides after a few days and then is constant.The temperature range is about 39-41 degrees when you play a game for about 20 mins.So i would advise heavy gamers to avoid this.
  

  Decent music quality-The phone has got a decent music quality.The headphones you get are average but i would suggest you to get a good pair but you have to test and buy it because i have seen a weird thing in micromax phones where the headphones are not able to give their potential output.Maybe its a problem with the 3.5 mm headphone jack which is made in this way!
  

  The phone has got a decent battery output as well-Earlier the battery used to drain quite easily but now i get a better battery backup.The phone will last you a day and a half with above average use with a single sim in.(come on its android!) havent tried the idea of buying a 3000 mah battery so i have a powerbank for emergencies which is going quite well for me.
  

  Micromax is not a company where you get high resale value so if you regret your decision later on the price you get even if you use it for like 10 days will be half :(
  
  conclusion- If you are looking to buy a  phone which you will use for a year then go for it.Its cheap and yes it will beat all the phones even falling under a 18000 price range like samsung :P
  

  Avoid it if you are a heavy gamer.!
  

  Otherwise go for it ! :) Its a steal :)
  

  Design-7/10
  

  Perfomance-8/10
  

  Gaming-8/10
  

  Camera-8/10
  

  Display-9/10
  

  Battery-7/10

column6: A Phone with a Good Return on Investment
column7:
I have been using this phone for the last  7 months and so far the experience is pretty good. Baring some storage hiccups overall a great buy in the price range.
  
  Pros:
  
  1. Baring only 1 occasion I never faced any issue with phone hanging up.
  
  2.The battery is pretty decent only that times it drains from 15% to 4% at alarmingly fast rate, but on moderate usage with internet on it lasts for ~ 10hrs on one charge.
  
  3. The camera through not of very high standard is good enough for indoor / morning out door shots, the video quality is pretty good.
  
  4. No issues faced with respect with network connection and it doesnt drop of calls all of a sudden.
  
  5. The voice quality is good too.
  
  6. Screen touch sensitivity is good too.
  

  Cons:
  
  1. The Phone storage is less that 900 MB in reality and most apps takes up the phone memory to save logging / page vist and other data. Since its preloaded with apps (some of them not even used) there is hardly space for installing another 8 extra app.
  
  even if there is 90 mb space installing 10 mb app gets stopped citing insufficient space !! Not sure why this happens
  
  One can use some app to clean up the cache memory and additional data created by the app. (but this causes loss of login info and location details among others)

column6: Low Internal Memory Problem Solved. (Compleate Product Review)
column7:
First I shall mention about low internal
  
  The phone have .89 gb internal app memory and 5.28 Gb internal sd card. Internal sd can be used for mass storage, it can not store installed apps. User initially gets 650 Mb free app storage ( rest is filled with uninstable system app and some useless pre installed apps installed by micromax which can not be uninstalled).
  
  Even you move a app to external sd (installed app can not be moved in internal 5.28 Gb sd) about 15-20 mb will remain in the app storage.
  
  Some apps even can not be moved to external sd( example facebook app eats about 90 mb of .89 gb app storage).
  
  Apps can not be installed when there is less than 130 Mb in the internal .89gb storage.
  
  Normally You can at most install 30 apps.
  
  I have solved this problen. To solve this you have to root this phone.
  
  The phone can not be rooted with framaroot apk.
  
  I rooted my phone with kingroot apk. (Do not mis confuse with kingoroot)
  
  kingroot is a chinese app but after rooting kinguser is installed in english. (google search about kingroot if you have doubt).
  
  After rooting you have to partition your external sd card using minitool partition wizard (pc softwere). Partitioning will wipe all sd card dada make a bacckup in pc before doing partition.
  
  Then download link2sd from google play store in your rooted phone.
  
  This app links (moves) all part of the app to the second partition of external sd card.
  
  google serarch about it (flipkart does not allow provide link in review)
  
  If you have any doubt google search about link2sd.
  
  After rooting never try to remove any system app using lik2sd or any othet root apps.
  
  After linking your internal memory do not open your sd card form your phone. If you need to remove the sd card first remove all the link using link2sd.
  
  Otherwise you will face trouble. To solve this trouble I had to factory reset my phone and repartion sd card using minitool partition wizard.
  
  link2sd plus (paid version of link2sd) is much more better than link2sd. I am using link2sd plus.
  
  Using link2sd you shall be able to keep about 90 apps. Link2sd plus have no limitition, apps storage will be only be linitted by your sd storage.
  
  Rooting will end your phones warranty.
  
  Before rooting first make sure that you do not have any hardwere problem.
  
  If you find any hardwere problem after rooting you have to flash the stock kitkat ROM Using sp flash tools. Then you will get back your wareanty. (Flashing Stock ROM solves any kind of softwere problem). Do not flash rom just for experiment purpose unless you really need.
  
  I am not responsible if anything wrong happens to you following this prcedure. Proceed at your own risk.
  
  The batrery Life Of this phone is really poor.
  
  It can not play video more than 4 hours with full screen brightness.
  
  You can not play games even for 3 hours with full charge battery.
  
  The phone does not support 32gb sd card as sd card. I purched samsung 32gb evo class 10 memory card. When i stored data more than 18 Gb entire phone started hanging. The phone could not be even shudded down. Turning out the battery was only way. ( I faced this problem before using link2sd. If you have any problem with your sd card, do not use link2sd with that sd).
  
  Now I am using a 16gb samsung nemory card with no problem.
  
  This phone supports OTG I am using the 32 Gb memory card in a card reader as usb storage in this phone for backups. The phones supports 32gb usb storage with no problem.
  
  The phone does not have compus and gyroscope
  
  Sience it does not have compus you can not find the Arrow sign of the pointer in google map you shall find yourself as a point in gogle map.
  
  Gameing preformance of this phone is really great No games lags in this phone.( Tested with NFS MOST WANTED and Gta san andress by me)
  
  These games cantain apk files ( Less than 30 Mb remains in app storage) And Sd data( more than 2 Gb remains in externl sd card).
  
  do not worry you can play this games without rooting your phone.
  
  The full hd display of micronax canvas 2 colours a120 (this phone) is great.

column6: A budget phone with good specs but poor battery performance
column7:
I have used this phone for a week now and am really starting to doubt most reviews that people have written on various sites around.
  

  Here's an honest account of what this phone offers:
  
  The Good:
  
  1. Display
  
  2. Camera (yes, it's pretty good. Zero shutter lag and good results too)
  
  3. Processor (high end games run well)
  
  4. User Interface (Though there is some bloatware, there is enough of the pure android experience to keep you happy)
  

  The Bad:
  
  1. Heats up when high processing is required.
  
  2. Apps hang frequently. (Yes, several crashes within the first week itself)
  

  The Ugly:
  
  1. Battery.
  
  My battery seems to have awful calibration.
  
  This happened a couple of times: It took 8 hours to go from 100% to 80% and then dropped to 0% within 2 minutes.
  
  2. A full charge takes upto 4 hours.
  
  3. Cant depend on the displayed battery percentage. The phone could let you down any minute.
  

  I thought this was a problem with the specific product that I got and hence asked Flipkart for a replacement which they graciously gave me. However, I see the same problem with the replaced piece. Surely has to do something with the model.

  The audio quality is excellent through the earphones and speakers. I have never enjoyed music more on any phone. The speaker is loud and clear, so I don't need any external speakers with this device.
  

  I haven't done much video recording but the images that come from the camera are of excellent quality  (both front and back). The camera is very user-friendly too. And for all the criticisms of the camera quality, I do not see why an everyday user would need a camera better than this.
  

  The performance of the phone is superior. The battery lasts really long (I charge once in two days after ample usage). The phone is speedy, I've never had any speed issues. Yes, there is bloatware that can be very easily ignored. The phone runs on the latest android version kitkat.
  

  I was personally hesitant to buy from an Indian manufacturer as I have heard about all sorts of quality issues. But my opinion has totally changed from personal experience. And even if I did, I do not see why I should shell out so much more just for a brand name.   My colleague Mr. Malay Toprani was having same problem of restart in Micromax Nitro which he had purchased from amazon.in with order reference number 402-4682635-8297166 and they have taken back the product.
  

  This mobile was taken back in extended period (22 days) in place of 10 days of their standard replacement guarantee as they have got complaints from maximum customers. They will take this issue with seller and manufacturer too.
  

  However Flipkart is unable to do the same and informing me to go to service center within just one month an 7 days of purchase (replacement guarantee was for 30 days). Its like marrying a woman with mental psychological problems and then leaving with her for rest of the life by patching it. Even when it is genuine customer problems Flipkart is sticking to their policy and not looking at taking this as exception and using their clout with manufacture Micromax.
  

  Earlier too I had purchased Micromax HD for my daughter but product quality lead to bad experience (twice changed battery & SIM card holder). I had thought this as aberration however second bad experience can not be coincidence. My Samsung S2 (even after 3 years now) just runs, in the hindsight it seems wrong decision to move away from Samsung, now again planning to move back & purchase Note III.

Short term ownership review: It is a nice phone in this price range.
  

  Camera - Both front nd rear camera are good in day light but are not meant for low light capturing.
  

  Performance - U can perform daily tasks nd can play games like subway surfer, hill climb racing etc without lagging.
  

  Storage - Storage is very low as out of 8gb only 3.8gb is available for ur use.
  

  Battery - With moderate usage(game play, whatsapp etc) the battery lasts for 8-10 hrs.
  

  Pros - It is a nice phone in this price range(Rs 3500 for me) if you want an android phone for general purpose like using whatsapp nd other light apps. Pls don't compare it with high end phones.
  

  Cons - There is one serious issue in this phone that it's android is configured in a way that u can't use applications like app lock because locking an app requires special permissions in android which this phone resets automatically. So app lock will never be able to lock any app in this phone. Although this is a good feature if u don't want app lock as it continuously optimizes ur phone for maximum battery life.
  

  Four stars because of the app lock issue.
  

  I appreciate flipkart's super fast delivery, thanks.

Short term ownership review: It is a nice phone in this price range.
  

  Camera - Both front nd rear camera are good in day light but are not meant for low light capturing.
  

  Performance - U can perform daily tasks nd can play games like subway surfer, hill climb racing etc without lagging.
  

  Storage - Storage is very low as out of 8gb only 3.8gb is available for ur use.
  

  Battery - With moderate usage(game play, whatsapp etc) the battery lasts for 8-10 hrs.
  

  Pros - It is a nice phone in this price range(Rs 3500 for me) if you want an android phone for general purpose like using whatsapp nd other light apps. Pls don't compare it with high end phones.
  

  Cons - There is one serious issue in this phone that it's android is configured in a way that u can't use applications like app lock because locking an app requires special permissions in android which this phone resets automatically. So app lock will never be able to lock any app in this phone. Although this is a good feature if u don't want app lock as it continuously optimizes ur phone for maximum battery life.
  

  Four stars because of the app lock issue.
  

  I appreciate flipkart's super fast delivery, thanks.

  Starting with the pros.

  Front camera 3.5/5.
  
  Back camera 4/5.
  
  2. Battery is a littile less but micromax has a very good battery management system and the battery lasy a one and a half day long with normal usage and if you play games like shadow fight etc. you need to charge the device in the afternoon only.You have to remove the full back cover for inserting both the SIM and micro sd card,but you get a sticker above the battery panel i.e. battery cannot be removed if need to replace your battery you should visit a Micromax service centre.
  
  Battery 4/5 ( considering its mAh and power management) .
  
  3.Display is good ,with 290 ppi.you get good viewing angle.
  
  Touch is smooth.brightness is fine.resolution is 1280x720. You only get onscreen navigation buttons so they take up the space while normal  usage but while playing games or movies they automatically hide down.
  
  Display 4.5/5.
  
  4.Design is pretty good the phone is slim.you can use the phone with one hand. The silver chrome finish on the front edge looks very appealing. The back pabel has a scratch proof design and os bit of dusty lookbut not a deal breaker.The navigatin buttons should be in the space provided below the screen. But it does not matter much.
  
  Design 4.5/5.
  
  5.Performance.
  
  2GB ram is enough for day to day task and micromax has a very good RAM management.
  
  You get 1.3 GHz MTK 6580 quad core processor. I have tried Shadow fight and Hitman sniper and they work very smoothly. Till now the phone did not hang while playing games or watching movies. 1080p movies run very smoothly withoit any lag.
  
  Performance 5/5
  
  6.Connectivity  you get Bluetooth. Wi-Fi. Wi-Fi Hotspot. 3G.2G.Edge. connectivity options .
  
  You do not get 4G here.
  
  You can buy a Jio-Fi device(only  999) to use 4G in it, so its not a big deal breaker.
  

  General verdict.
  
  No large issues with this phone if you are a normal+ gaming user you should buy this phone.
  
  And Good work micromax

column6: You can't get anything better than this in this price range.
column7:
I bought this phone from flipkart on 02-04-2014 after reading some good reviews. But now I am regretting. This is one of the worst phones I've ever used in my life. I got this phone on 4th april, 2014. Unfortunately for the first time sim slot 1 was not working, so I replaced it. Thanks to flipkart, I got a new piece on 06-04-2014. But situation is still grave. Touch is not working properly, battery backup is decent but phone hangs a lot and not even able to play temple run 2 properly. I raised a complaint again.
  

  Update as on 27th April, 2014
  
  As, I have mentioned in my previous review. I had raised a complaint and I wanna thank flipkart for providing me technical support. They called me the very next day and sorted my problem. Basically it was a problem related to software. I had to hard reset my phone.
  

  Now come to the point, the phone is excellent. And I think I'm lucky to have this wonderful phone. People say that 512 mb ram is not enough, I agree with them but due to powerful quadcore processor & videocore GPU (Better than adreno 305) you won't feel any lagging. I have tested it with almost every high graphics games like Shadowguns, Dead trigger 2, Six Guns, Iron Man, The amazing spiderman, Asphalt 8 and trust me I have no problem while running those games.
  

  Lets discuss some other topics briefly.
  
  Pros.
  
  1) Sound output is good both via loudpeaker and headphones.
  
  2) 1.2 Ghz Quadcore processor with videocore gpu will provide you better gaming performance.
  
  3) Built and looks of phone make you confused. You'll feel like you are using a 15k+ phone.
  
  4) Battery backup is decent.
  
  5) Viewing angle of display is excellent.
  
  6) Display is vivid and crisp.
  
  7) Internet speed is excellent.
  
  8) It can run full hd videos.
  
  9) Calling is also good.
  
  10) Last but not the least after spending this much you will get 5mp autofocus camera both front and rear. Camera quality is excellent and flash is powerful.
  
  Cons.
  
  The only drawback that I found is ugly signal bar.

  1. It looks awesome.
  
  2. The camera combo (5-5) is good. The camera clarity is decent, though I'm not much of a photographer.The front camera takes pretty cool selfies.
  
  3.The 1.2 Ghz Snapdragon processor which helps you perform basic tasks like messaging with ease...

  1.THE RAM. Despite the exceptional processor inside , the RAM is so little , that you cannot install too many apps or multitask efficiently without suffering unbearable lags...
  
  Like I said , you can only perform basic tasks like messaging. Out of the 512 mb , a large part goes for system applications...the remainder is paltry and is not enough for anyone who likes to play games extensively or try out the latest apps or browse the internet. Other than the preinstalled apps in the device , you can hardly install a couple of
  
  extra apps/games.I'm not talking about high end games.I'm talking about simple and basic games like Subway Surfers , Temple Run.Of all such games that I'd tried out...only Hill Climb Racing had zero lag when played at any given hour .The RAM is almost entirely why you shouldn't buy this phone.
  
  2.The battery is pretty weak ....With extensive and heavy usage ,it can be finished in a hour or two.
  
  3.It heats up a lot when used heavily.
  
  4.The operating system(4.2.2 Jellybean) is outdated...No updates available..Trust me .
  
  5.The accessories are of cheap quality and don't last long.
  

  Verdict: The RAM lets down the user entirely...Nowadays , phones with over than 1Gb are preferred...Anyone who is an app geek or a serious gamer , or any one who expects their device to provide them seamless performance , will never buy this device. column6: Very Very Very Very Very Good Phone For Such A Low Price
column7:
Firstly , it is really very good "Basic Mobile Phone" (Joy X1850) for such a low price. I am very pleased with the phone. But it is true inspite of a very good phone it has some drawbacks but those are not a bigger issue to not to buy the phone . Friends, it is really a good phone .
  
  I have just got yesterday the phone. And I pleased with the build quality and look of the phone. It is a handful size and good to look with wide decent but simple keys. Though the keys are quite stiff but O.K. It has 1800 mah big marathon battery and I think it will go through the week easily, as other users says. Screen is good. But lack of a vibration disappointed me. Its ringtone volume is very low so that vibration is a must for the phone that it lacks. And one thing I most prefer in any phone that it lacks, a second speaker for music and ring tones but the voice clarity is superb and sufficient to heard. One speaker for all it always a issue for health , it puts pressure in ears. But for a low price phone it is a very good phone. And I find some lack of menu functions but memorising the price that's O.K. Over all it is a very very good phone everyone must buy if they want a budget, tough and dual sim phone for alltime use.
  
  So, ending my long review I summarise it's main pros and cons , just look -
  
  Pros : 1. Low Price
  
  2. Dual SIM
  
  3. 1800 mah marathon battery
  
  4.Good simple but elegant look
  
  5.Tough and hard build quality
  
  6.In spite of Low price it has a surprisingly good low resolution camera
  
  7.It has music and video player
  
  8.Micro USB charging point
  
  9.It has a decent torchlight function
  
  10.It has memory card slot
  
  Cons: - mainly
  
  1.It has a longer pin micro usb
  
  2.Very low ring tone sound
  
  3. No vibration mode
  
  So, in this price range it is really a very good Basic Mobile Handset with Dual SIM function and I recommend to all who need for this type of phone just buy it , it don't disappoint you.

I ordered this phone for my sister as her first phone. I had no big expectations on this phone. When the phone arrived, The packaging was impressive. I'll describe my observations so far.
  

  Display: The phone's display is as premium as any mid end Samsung phone. The colors are vivid. The touch screen is also well responsive considering the price.
  

  Performance: With an Octa Core processor and Mali 450 MP4, it's the most powerful phone at this price range. There are no visible lags as of now. The UI is fluid as it should be.
  

  Camera: This is where the phone is a killer. This 13MPX killer camera captures pictures better than my Yuphoria and don't underestimate the 2MPX front camera. The front camera's quality is also satisfactory but the pictures are grainy in low light.
  

  Sensors: The only place where the phone lags. It doesn't have Magnetic and Gyro Sensor. So this phone will not be compatible with any VR Cardboards.So, People who think about experiencing Virtual Reality with this phone, Make a note.
  

  Battery Backup: I was probably expecting too much of Juice from this 2500mAh battery but got disappointed as the phone discharged from 100% to 34% in around 3 hours with 30% brightness and no Sim Cards and only Wi-Fi. But the minimum brightness is probably enough for most of the time as it's treshold is greater than most of the phones. But the Micromax Update app was consuming 24% of the battery in the background.I'll force close it and update the results later.But with optimum brightness and two SIM Cards on stand-by, it should give you at least 5 hours of backup which is average for almost every phone. So, Nothing exceptional in battery backup.
  

  LED Notification Light looks like a bonus for this phone. Many phones at this price range don't have one. You will not know when it'll be useful. Without a LED Notification, You'll never know if your phone fully charged or has a notification until you turn on the display.
  

  And finally, The phone sports killer looks. It looks very premium and very well reasonable in this price. The earphones provided with this phone sounds like Beats. Never recieved such high quality earphones with any other phone. Upvote if you find it useful :)
  

  Updates:
  
  This phone has some software issues. The phone slows down occasionally. And suddenly there was a problem with the camera. When you open the Camera App, There is a grey screen in the viewfinder. This can be temporarily fixed by going to Settings->Apps->All->Camera->Clear Data. Then it will take few weeks for it to build up cache and this problem might occur again. The only permanent fix for these issues is a software update by Micromax which is promised. Let's hope Micromax fixes these bugs in the Lollipop Update.

Hello fellas...
  

  I bought this cellphone last year during its fresh online sale. I was very impressed with the features and specifications of this phone at this very affordable price. I started reading reviews and ratings of this cell phone over the internet and found most reviews positive hence it was fresh sale during that period so reviews were made after using it for a week or two. I decided to buy this cell phone anyhow.
  

  During its next online sale, I bought this phone and received within a week. While using it I observed that it has some issue with its speaker so I made a complaint to Flipkart and replaced it with new phone. Then my cell phone worked fine for few months. In early 2016, a software update was appeared on my screen and downloaded and installed it which upgraded my Android OS from Kitkat to Lolipop. Then my real trouble was started, my phone become slower and started legging while using any heavy application like Games or Whatsapp. Even the touch pad also become another irritation. Whenever I type any character it clicks another character and automatically clicks started. I reset my cell phone for 2-3 times but it didn't worked. Then Whenever I get any incoming call I cannot pickup at once because tough pad doesnt work properly at all so I have to press power button to lock it 1-2 times to pick up a call. Then my cellphone's mic also stopped working and I need to use speaker to talk with someone. The memory allocated for inbuilt apps is also very less so I can't install more 3rd part applications and RAM is not available to run my apps with speed. The battery has issue like it drains so fast and sometimes I charge it it becomes fully charged within 15 minute and stop charging anymore and then after using it for another 20-30 mins the battery becomes drained again so that's another big problem for me. But the phone is very light, stylish and looks like an Apple iPhone. The camera quality is also great for both sides.
  

  Now I am left with a cellphone that hangs a lot, microphone is not working, insufficient memory for apps and battery life and unhealthy touch pad. So I believe you should think thrice before paying your money on this smartphone. There are another options as well that gives you better specification on very low price. I am not saying that Micromax produces worst cellphones because my last Canvas A76 smartphone from MMX is great as anything and still working properly. But I suggest you should not pay money for a cellphone that is only available during limited period online sale at very low price because there are always some issues appears on such phone that's why they sale them at such a low price.

Micromax Express 2 offers great value for money. I have been using for a week. Works as expected, no  lags anywhere, software is minimalistic Android and Features offered for price are great. Here are some Pros and Cons.
  

  Pros:
  
  *Processor is Octa Core which is awesome for this price
  
  *Good Quality 720p Screen with vibrant colours and sufficient contrast.
  
  *Good Build Quality even though its all plastic, also looks quite premium.
  
  *Excellent Battery Life for an average consumer, may last 1.5 days with mild usage.
  
  *Call Quality is very good and dual SIM support
  
  *Camera is very good due to resolution and bigger sensor, but somewhat lacks in quality and color accuracy.
  

  Cons:
  
  *No 4G LTE
  
  *No Lollipop out of the box (God only knows when it will get updated)
  
  *Speaker is on quieter side.
  
  *Somewhat bloatware loaded on the phone (but can be uninstalled easily)
  
  *Headphones in the box are below average.

Good delivery time from Flipkart. I am using Xpress2 for over a month. Its a good to go for such price range. slightly over priced (why refer the cons).
  

  Pros-
  
  1. Good display. viewing angle is good.
  
  2. Comes with Gorilla glass but still suggest to go with Tempered glass protector. (I moved from Canvas 2.2 just because I broken my front glass and after 2 replacement it din't give me original feel).
  
  3. Decent battery, like my Canvas 2.2 it goes 1 day with full charge.
  
  3. With regular apps, like Whatsapp, facebook etc. 1Gb RAM is good. Internal space of 5+Gb is good but lacks option to move apps to external memory.
  
  4. Its OctaCore but I hardly felt any difference in this any my old Canvas 2.2.
  
  Cons -
  
  1. No option to move apps to SD card. It gives option of default memory selection but restrict only for the camera pics n videos.
  
  2. Apps data is also dumped in internal memory, for Whatsapp like app its disaster. you need to regularly move pics n videos to external memory card MANUALLY.
  
  3. No option to import/ export SMS. Was a great option in my Canvas 2.2.
  
  4. When camera is open for long time its heating.
  
  5. Some times feels lagging. Some settings need to be turned off for it, like by default your location service is ON. check this is your battery usage screen.
  
  6. Its manual shows both bottom hole lines as speaker, reality is only the right one is spear. cover that and there is no sound.
  
  7. The earpiece is just a Round whole, unlike a wide strip. If you just move your cell, and you will find no voice from other party. But you will be used-to with this in a week.
  
  8. One useless sticky - Camera shortcut on lock screen. It protect your privacy by showing only just taken pic but I wish to remove it.
  
  - So if you are a regular user with day-to-day task go for it. If you are a heavy gamer, don't even think this, Octa core will hardly give you anything.
  
  For few good very basic things I really miss from my Canvas 2.2 and disappointed from Micromax. One less star for above.
  

  MMX have lost one more Star (I gave 4 earlier). My phone now start making issue just in 1-2 month. Few times it just restarted without any reason, enough RAM n internal memory available all time. :X

column6: Bought it on 1st July. Dead on 26th August.
column7:
I stepped down from Samsung Note, and bought this in hope it will do me all the purpose with less fear of losing big amount in case of theft (as I travel a lot). But I was wrong.
  

  Day to Day Usage:
  
  In daily usage the phone seems ok, touch is not that good as of samsung, but it was expected due to price difference.
  
  The thing annoyed me from 1st day was its ear piece, the incoming voice was never clear and I always struggled in conversation. But due to busy schedule couldn't fetch time to return/replace it.
  
  The thing I liked was, it rarely hanged.
  

  Applications and Memory:
  
  If you use a lot of applications, then you will find the space is just not enough for you and it keeps on giving low memory error when trying to install new apps. Please mind that I don't play Games and just use the office productive applications. Which are less heavier than games. It has only 1.3GB available for installing the apps, and after using 1GB it starts giving the error.
  

  Beside above said issues, I was ok and kinda happy with phone. But then the terror day came, At 2PM I was trying to order Mi3 phone at flipkart, and after that I kept the phone in pocket and when I checked at 2.15PM my phone was DEAD. Nothing happened. No display, not taking charge, nothing at all It was completely dead.
  

  Service Centers:
  
  I went to service center next day, and shocked to see the poor facility and management there. It felt like I have come to take kerosine oil in Rashan (no offence to anybody).
  

  I reached at sharp 10am there, it was the time they have mentioned they start dealing with customer. But they said we start working at 10:30am. Wow great customer service.
  

  After that, the manager of facility took few calls on priority as per his wish, one I could understand was of senior citizen, but rest two was of two college girls... why so??
  

  My token no. was 17, and it took almost 2 hours for my turn. Then they checked it and said its dead and motherboard has to be replaced. I asked when I should collect... they said AT LEAST AFTER 10-12 DAYS. Changing a motherboard takes this much time.. :O
  

  I found its no point saying anything to these people. And pledged never buy a mmx phone  in future. Company is Indian, but its all Chinese, that too cheap Chinese product.
  

  I was stuck as my phone is my business partner, so ordered a Moto G yesterday, who knows how long they might take after said 12 days.
  

  Verdict:
  
  The phone looks nice in hands, and attracts people for its price, but cheap hardware is cheap. If it works then great else you are screwed. If you are a true business user, then stay away from these products. For college guys its great.
  

  ------ Micromax Customer (Dont)Care is a Nigthmare
  

  Its been a month now, but micromax is not able to fix my phone yet. More surprising is they texted me on 15-Sep, that my phone is ready for pickup. I went there on 23rd-Sep due to busy schedule, and I was shocked to know that nothing is done yet. They kept searching for 30 minutes and when I loosed my patience I approached manager, and he gave me ultimate reply:
  
  "The message about repair was from Micromax Company, not by us"
  
  I was so flattered with the reply that I couldn't utter a word for 15 seconds, then regaining my senses, I asked "Is I am at some other company's service center?"
  
  Then he asked me to wait outside saying, "I have other work also, wait outside". Then I again asked, what work you have other than serving the customers in customer service center?
  
  He was out of mind by this question started shouting "who sent this guy in my office and blah blah"
  
  Then I simply told him to call me whenever the phone is ready, as I dont have time to fight with him.
  

  LESSON LEARNED:NEVER GO WITH CHINESE COMPANIES. PEOPLE SAYS ITS INDIAN, BUT ONLY OWNERS ARE INDIAN REST ALL IS CHINESE, INCLUDING MANNERS OF STAFF.
  

  Advice for others: If you believe in luck and think you have strong one, then mmx is your game. Rest stay away.

  6. 4Gb internal space but 1.42 GB is user available and can be extended upto 32GB. I use an 8GB micro sd card which works good for me .
  

  7. Battery life is satisfactory . Since it is an android device so it is common with most of the devices so its not a big thing to worry about . Still for an average use it last for 12-15 Hrs which is not bad .
  

  8. Large apps can be easily moved to external SD card so no issue with the memory.
  

  9. Internet browsing experience is creamy . It loads quick in time . personally I liked that experience very good. I recommend using chrome browser for browsing.
  

  10. Black color phone looks quite premium .
  

  11. Build quality is quite nice. No issue with the build quality.
  

  12. HD recording is surprisingly great for this device.
  

  13. Bluetooth experience is very fast. You can also play songs on your laptop directly from your device without connecting it to laptop from any cable but with Bluetooth
  

  14. Charger is in  combination with the data cable.
  


  cons:
  

  1. Camera Quality is satisfactory , not of high standards as compared to Nokia. Still images captured are clear with good colors. For camera lovers I won't recommend it.
  

  2. Call Quality is very average. I disliked this the most in this phone . If it would be better I would have given 5 stars. Strictly not recommended to those who makes a lot of calls everyday. column6: Tried & tested !! Good value for money..
column7:
Have been using Canvas A114 since buying it from Flipkart in July 2014, and am very satisfied with it. .Briefly speaking:
  
  Pros:
  
  1.Good display, LED-notification light, decent camera with flash.
  
  2.No lag ( I move apps to SD card wherever possible, and my free-memory (RAM) with apps running is never less than 400-500MB). Hung and restarted on its own, only twice in these 5-6 months.
  
  3.Pre Loaded apps can be removed / disabled without any adverse hang-ups.
  
  4.Decent battery backup (30-36 hours) unless I use 3g heavily in automatic refreshing sites like moneycontrol or mobile trading apps.
  
  Cons:
  
  1.Had an unbelievable experience once- the phone had been put on charger, and two numbers from my contacts got dialed on their own. (it wasn't the usual kids stuff as he was at school, and I only came to know of it when i received call-backs from those two persons). I expected either some app or OS-malfunction. So i removed some preloaded apps immediately- Spuul, hike, dancing bubbles, bubbleX slice, Milive, MiLife etc which i considered useless for me. NEVER experienced it again consequent to it.
  
  2.BEWARE that it has mobile tracker, and so sends sms to a fixed number everytime the browser is connected UNLESS YOU CHANGE THE HOMEPAGE. I only came to know of it when i saw some 100-odd rupees in sms charges in my postpaid-bill. NEVER experienced it again once I changed the default micromax homepage that came perloaded.
  
  3.Hope and pray that you are not amongst those 2-3% people who get the defective piece (I call it the Made-in-China risk)
  

  My brother has been using it for last two years, and only spent 200-odd rupees during this time once when the microphone got bad. So, I am thinking of buying third one in my family, rather than going for cheaper but untried & yet-to-be-tested RedMi or ASUS phones.

  Good looking

  Loud speaker

  CONS:

column6: A good performer (Review after 3 months of usage)
column7:
Hello friends.. I have purchased this mobile on July 12, 2014.. Not from Flipkart though but from a local store in Kolkata for 9K... for the past three months i have been using my device a lot and here is my review on the same..
  
  Pros:
  
  1) Looks- What attracted me is the looks of the phone.. The device with the premium leather finish and elaborate stitches seemed so premium that i could not stop myself from getting one from myself.. The design is simply gorgeous.. The metal brezel around the sides look so premium.. Trust me you will fall in love with the looks..
  
  2) Screen- Micromax has given an HD screen to the device.. The colour reproduction and viewing angles are really good.. !! I mean really good.. trust me.. The vivid colours look too awesome... The 5 inch screen is good enough for my purpose.. however i did find some pixellation while reading PDF files and word documents... The video playback is really nice although i use MX player...
  
  3) Battery- The 2000mAh battery of my Elanza 2 lasts around a day... I really get great battery back up infact.. I listen to a lot of songs, play a lot of games, browse the internet.. All these are done on a moderate to heavy basis and my battery runs almost through the day... To be more precise with heavy usage the battery lasts around 12-14 hours which is quite good..
  
  4) Performance- The 1gb ram and the qualcomm chipset makes the device a great performer. My Elanza 2 runs butter smooth without any major hiccupps.. Casual games like Temple Run, Subway surfers, Candy Crush, Beach Buggy, Candy Crush, Fruit Ninja, run really well... Internet  connectivity via 3G, 2G, Wifi is good.. The music quality is great.. The headset given in the sales package is also good.... But i would advice get a good pair of headphones for better music quality... I use SkullCandy 2XL headsets and the sound output is great... The call quality is also good...
  
  5) Camera- The 8 megapixel rear cam clicks nice pictures.. The front 2 megapixel camera is good enough for decent selfies.. Anyways, i am not much of a selfie lover... So it does not really affect me much...
  
  All in all the phone is a power packed device at a great price range...
  

  Cons:
  
  1) Low Internal memory- The low internal phone memory is one of the serious downside of this device... with time cache files, gallery thumbnails fill up the internal phone memory.. However, you can overcome this issue.. Install Clean Master and Disk Usage and Storage Analyser from play store to detect and clean those junk files and ensure your device run smoothly
  
  2) Auto Sleep- Another problem which i have faced kind of rarely, is the problem that my automatically shuts down even though the battery is full.. Anyways if that happens just open your back cover, remove and re-insert your battery and you are done.. In fact, after the automatic sleep thing my device actually performs faster..!! ha ha ha.. !!
  
  3) Reverie Lag- Somestimes while typing long messages or posts the Reverie keyboard and the phone dialler lags.. Though the lag is occassional but i find it to be a problem..
  

  To sum up, a good phone at a very good price.. Do consider it as an option if you are planning to buy a new phone.. !!!

I purchased this phone couple of weeks back. I explored almost all the phone around ~12K budget including MotoG, Lenovo, Sony etc. plus Micromax A121 and A120. Always had a tendency to go with a renowned brand so my preference was MotoG. But couple of my friends who bought that phone are facing network issues. Plus for almost the same kind of features i am paying almost 6K plus. So i nailed down on A121 and A120. I went for A121 just because the processor is from Qualcomm. Now from the usage of the phone
  
  - Overall phone looks neat and good.
  
  - Phone display is very nice. Especially with the leather like back cover from MM.
  
  - Display is very clear and crisp.
  
  - Graphics performance look neat. I am not a power gamer but temple run 2 i keep playing. No lag..no heating up.
  
  - Phone is fast and never experienced any lag till now.
  
  - Battery life with full time Wifi ON comes to 1.5 days.
  
  - Camera is very good. Front and back.
  

  Now the disadvantages :
  

  - Phone is bit heavy i felt.
  
  - Music/Sound is neat - but i felt it may have been better.
  
  - I feel, the display brightness control in Auto mode is not working neatly.
  

  Overall i feel, this phone is pretty good buy; value for money- if you are not obsessed with high end brands. Most of the brands just take money for their brand name.

One more thing is, each time i open whatsapp gallery, it creates a huge thumbnail fine and memory gets full. Overall i am really pissed off with the memory of this phone. column6: best product in this price range
column7:
I purchased this mobile on 4th Nov 2013 @Rs 7599/- and here is the review after using it for 3 months.
  
  .....
  
  WS Retails delivery was superb as usual.
  

  Specification is same as mentioned on flipkart except Battery type. It is Li-ion not Li-Polymer.
  

  Looks is amazing just like a premium one.You can hold it easily in one hand as its having solid matte finish back panel and edges are also curved to perfection.
  

  Display is very good. Pixel density is good (196 ppi). One can easily find true color thanks to 16 m color. There is one drawback... top viewing angle is bad.
  

  Touch sensitivity is awesome. super smooth touch. Provided screen guard is ok, but go for a good (scratchguard clear) screenguard.
  

  This phone is fast no lags at all. But some times its lags if you install lots of application. There is some useless pre-loaded apps installed better to uninstall or disable them. 512 mb ram is enough (considering the price). Use some ram manager application to kill some apps running on background.
  

  HD and Full-HD videos runs superbly.
  

  Most high end games runs like a charm thanks to dual core cpu and Mali-400 GPU.
  

  Rear Camera is not at all 5 MP. Picture and Video quality is also ok not so good. Secondery camera is .3 mp just ok for making video calls.
  

  Battery backup is fine. I won't say its good. It last 1 - 1.5 day for normal usage. (wifi + data, on, browsing for some time, playing some low end games, making some calls). But if you are playing high end games like NFS or browsing heavily it will last for max 3 - 4 hrs.
  

  Connectivity is very very good. Browsing experience is amazing no lags at all. I am using airtel Wi-fi broadband and airtel 3G..and this device is superfast on those.
  

  Provided ear piece is very good....thanks to Micromax for proving such good accessories.
  

  Verdict: You will find same or even better configured mobiles in this range from Karbonn or Xolo. But I opted for Micromax for its brand value and after sales support (haven't tested though :P).

column7:
I purchased this marvel from Micromax for Rs. 8,000 in October'13. I bought it from a local shop in Nehru Place. Initially I wanted to have a Blue colour, but since blue colour was unavailable at that shop, I took Red. Thank God for that!
