  Now about the phone. This phone works like a charm. Till now I am quite happy that I made this decision to purchase Canvas A76. I have used my friends Samsung Galaxy Grand and S Duos. This phone has all the features (Except 1GB RAM and Magnetometer) of Grand for almost half the price! However, even after having 1GB of RAM, Grand is too slow and it hangs more often. I am using 12-15 apps and my phone never hanged yet. Although at times it shows some lag due to low RAM. But this is manageable. It is not that much irritating as in Samsung Grand (after having 1 GB RAM) LOL. Now the Pros and Cons....
  

  PROS:
  
  1) Damn Good looks and solid made. When I take it out in Bus or Metro, people asks me often  - "Kaun sa phone hai? Mast lag raha hai.."
  
  2) 5" display with 480*854 resolution (means 160*159 DPI). HD videos and Images looks crisp and sharp. Brightness levels can be managed through Light Sensor.
  
  3) 1.26 Ghz ARMv7 dual core processor makes multitasking butter smooth.
  
  4) It comes with Android 4.2.2 (Jelly Bean) which makes A76's operation butter smooth.
  
  5) I have played Temple Run 2, Temple Run Oz and Subway Surfers on my phone. These all runs without any lag due to MALI 400 GPU.
  
  6) It has 3 axis Accelerometer, Proximity Sensor & Ambient Light Sensor. All these helps in better optimization of phone and better gaming experience.
  
  7) It has 2000 mah battery. I leave my home at 8 AM with 100% charging. My usage pattern - Wi-fi remains on during office hours. Few downloads over wi-fi, browsing, facebook and whatsapp chats for 3-4 hours, games and music player for 1-2 hour and 1-2 hour of voice calling. When I reach my home at around 9PM, charging remains 25%-35%. Means battery lasts over a day. Pretty good for an Android device.
  
  8) Good music quality over in-built speakers. Its 'treble' level is amazing. Although music volume is not that much loud but its crystal clear. After manual adjustment of equaliser, you can hear almost every beat of a song in detail. However, the in-ear type ear phones provided with the phone looks impressive but does not delivers that much music quality.
  
  9) Super smooth touch.
  
  10) Good network reception and call quality. Fast internet browsing.
  
  11) Original MMX screen-guard provided in the packaging box.
  
  12) I often use its front camera for Skype calling over wi-fi or 3G, and pretty much satisfied with the calls (voice and video).
  

  Now CONS: (though its not many)
  
  1) Not so good camera quality as compared to Nokia, Samsung or Sony. But look at  the price difference too. In day light it clicks good pics with its 5MP lens. But pics are grainy when taken in artificial light. Also there is one or two seconds of shutter lag. Means when you hit the click button, after 2 seconds scene will be captured. But this does not matter to me as camera is never a consideration for me while buying a phone.
  
  2) Low RAM. Sometimes you feel restricted due to low RAM but look at the price too. Samsung's 15-20K phone with 1GB RAM could not get that much user satisfaction in terms of performance and smooth operation.
  
  3) Viewing angles are not good.
  
  4) It can't play 1080p videos smoothly, even in MX Player, 1080p Video frame and audio skips at a regular interval. However, 720p videos runs pretty well.
  

  VERDICT:
  
  If you are searching for a very good phone under 8K, Canvas Fun A76 is the ultimate choice. I highly recommend it.
  
  Thank you Micromax for such a good and VFM product.

I bought this phone few weeks back..for my Dad.
  
  First thing I would like to mention that the delivery timing is absolutely brilliant. I ordered, and with in 48hrs I received the product.

  1. Matt finishing (back side/cover), but feels very nice in hand. Not slippery.
  
  2. Finger print magnet..( unless your hands are clean or have dry hands)
  
  3. Voice quality is very good. via. speaker and mic.)
  
  4. Screen touch response is very good and the is no lagging in using the phone using multitasking features. It opens every app very smoothly and very fast as-well.
  
  5. Video quality is quite fine but not brilliant, as it's only 720p. However, playing video on you tube in some cases it shows on 480p resolution. Specially if you are already using or have used an full HD phone. Like I am already using Samsung Galaxy S4.
  
  6. Gaming is very smooth on this device, It can easily handle a game like Asphalt 8. With fairly no lagging or game crashing,
  
  7. Rear Camera is 5MP, which has done a decent job. Well, there is bit issue in low light conditions but then you got the flash. :) . Which can't be used in some low light areas where auto night mode would be very helpful and would have given better quality pictures.
  
  Front camera has not given the performance or picture quality what was expected. For Selfies ;)
  
  8. Last comes the battery... Well I'll have to say that wasn't I expected. It just has 1700 mAh but it still gives so much better performance that some other phones in this range. It gives you full day with fair amount of usage ...like, calls, playing music and videos, internet usage. Which gives you enough juice at the end of the day that you can reach home and plug in the charger before going to sleep. or let's say around 9 or 10p.m.
  

  At-last, I would say in this price range this can been a very good option for you. If you want a budget phone and also need quality and performance as well.. Then, this is the one you should buy.

It's great, the build is excellent, personally, I love phones with screens of 4.5 inch to 5 inch, others start looking too big. Display is perfect for this screen size, bright with vibrancy in colour. The 1700mAh battery is good, not great, but is good enough for getting you through 4 hours of continuous heavy usage, the size mode makes it easy for saving battery when the phone is idle for a long time.
  

  The software (Stock Android) is just awesome, I brought this phone specifically for this, Nexus phones are expensive and other stock Android phones are just not fit for me. Plus, the phone will receive updates till at least the end of this year, another great reason to buy the phone.
  

  The rear 5 MP Camera is great, picture quality is better than a standard camera, the front facing camera isn't that good, but paired with proper lighting, it can give great pictures. Videos are truly HD from the rear camera. Overall, great, and yes, you can't justify everything by calling it a budget phone, in fact, the 5000+ price tag still needs to give something more deserving than this, since there are better phones available in this price segment.

  Speaker is not as good as the one in Moto e as it's back facing and has distortion in high pitches. Ear speaker is not very loud but decent
  
  Battery:
  
  1700mah battery can give your 3hr of SOT(screen on time) if you don't turn on Wi-Fi, cellular data, location, Bluetooth. I always leave then turn on and only manage to get between 2 to 2 .
  
  Build quality:
  
  Again can't match Moto e. White back over is just a dirt magnet. Received many dents after few drops but the screen manages to unshatter in major ones.
  
  Camera:
  
  5 MP front and 2 MP back camera is decent with simple Google camera app. HDR mode is great so I recommend you to left HDR always on which can deliver good low light performance and depth of fill. But the phone is not made for mobile photographers
  
  Performance:
  
  1.2ghz quad core mediatech processor can manage any task you throw at it. With combination of 1gb RAM this is one of the fastest phones off its price. I didn't even face any lag with almost 50 apps installed with the latest updates of installed Google apps. Not even while playing games like XCOM enemy within, GTA San Andreas, call of duty strick team, dark Knight rises etc.
  
  Storage:
  
  You'll get around 5 GB as internal in marshmallow after updating all the pre install apps. I'll recommend you to put a 32 GB class 10 memory card in it and make the SD card internal storage. Then you'll never run out of storage.
  
  Software:.
  
  This is the thing for which I bought this phone. A pure stock Android experience with only three third party apps installed which can easily be disabled. The pre installed is in 5.0. After buying it immediately got 6.0 and 6.0.1 and security patch up to November, 2016.
  
  Conclusion:
  
  I'm a pure Google service user and Google apps work best with stock Android. Only androidone can give you a experience like Nexus in very low cost. If you're also a person who is heavily invested in Google services and apps there is no other options on sick a low price, otherwise I'll not recommend you androidone.
  
  And one thing, androidone will not receive nougat and also Google Assistant.

  4) Butter smooth... No hanging.. No over heating... No app crash so far (never played games in this)

  6) Photo clarity is very good in outdoor (sunlight) condition
  
  Cons:
  
  1) Rear Camera is 5MP & it is better compared with Moto E (1st Gen) but still could have been improved in clarity in low light condition (indoor)
  
  2) Loud speaker sound could have been better but simply ok (MOTO E 1st gen & 2nd Gen outbeats A1 in this category)
  
  3) Better resolution display is missing... but still better (MOTO E both models out beats A1 in this category as well)
  
  4) Internal storage is just 4 GB... Need minimum of 8GB by looking at current available models in market
  
  Having said all these I would still strongly advice this product for the moderate smartphone users (not gaming users since I never experienced single gaming in this phone) as it is GREAT value for money at this moment (equivalent good compared with MOTO E 1st gen).

column6: Check thoroughly the IEMI number with invoice and the phone
column7:
Placed order for the new phone on 1 February 2017,  and received the parcel on  on 8 th February 2017, with tampered seal , hided with tightly covered plastic cover.
  

  It took good amount of time to identify the tampered seal and discrepancy in the IEMI numbers.
  


  Within an hour, I contacted the customer care due the following reasons (1. Old phone, 2. Damaged 3. Back cover full of dirt and scratches)
  
  Customer care offered a refund over telephonic conversation.
  

  On the next day  9 th  Feb 2017, I had a notification for replacement instead of refund.
  

  On 10 Feb 2017,  the delivery boy informed me that the product is ready for replacement.
  

  But he couldnt replace the product as the IEMI number was different and he informed me that he didnt recive any official communication from flipkart to replace the phone.
  

  I really dont understand how did he offered the call and came all the way to replace the product on without instructions from flipkart !
  

  Further conversations on the same day,  with customer care officer,  immediately after the departure of the delivery boy advised me that the customer care is not aware of his arrival and replacement offer.
  
  In this conversation, the customer care officer requested the bank details for refund.  As I was not ready with bank details at that time, I requested an hour time to get back with the documents needed.
  

  In the next call after one hour to provide bank  details for refund (requested by flipkart), the customer care officer said there is no option for refund, only replacement since IEMI number is different.

column6: Nice luking,handy handset with poor battery
column7:
I have used big battery + large screen phones.my last phone was coolpad note 3. My father's phone broke so i gave my phone to him. So i decided to buy a small cheap phone for use till diwali. Now coming to the phone....received  it on 9th july 2016(VTMSLP seller). Box was sealed. But after opening it was not well packaged like all phones. All things are new, not used. Bt felt like someone had opened the box once. Anyways, manufacturing date was may 2015.
  
  It is the 8gb white version. Almost 5gb storage was free out of it.
  
  Pros-
  
  1. There are many phones in market having better specs than this under 5k. Bt i bought it just because of ANDROID ONE feature. U will get all the latest android updates from google on ur phone before anyone else. I updated my phone to marshmallow. After that i have received so many small updates. Gud to have this. :)
  
  2. Both the Cameras are gud for the price.
  
  3. Rear loud speaker is rich in sound. I liked it. Loud n gud bass.
  
  4. Touch response is really good. U will love typing on this phone.
  
  5. Small and handy. Can operate wid single hand.
  
  6. Smooth ui and performance for normal multitasking.
  

  Cons-
  
  1. Battery life is below average. Yes, it is just 1700 mah battery but my frnd's gionee v4s having same specs with 1800 mah gives better battery life.
  
  I am a heavy user(no gaming), so i have to charge it 3-4times a day. For gaming it will drain quickly.
  

  2. Screen is good but very reflective. If u r coming from HD screen phones, u will find it pixelated. Bt will do the purpose. Button are on-screen. No capacitive keys here.
  

  3. After updates it is consuming more ram. So dont expect heavy multitasking.if u do, It will show 0 mb ram free. N home screen will stuck.
  
  For moderate operations like 5 apps in background,it is fine.
  

  4. No 4g. Well, I dont have it in my area, so no issues for me.
  

  5. Some likes stock android some not. I personally dont like it. Customisations are very less.no extra features like call recording, double tap to wake, ram cleaner etc.
  
  It also doesnt show any up down arrow sign  near network signals(like other phones)when mobile data is on. Which is quite annoying. Everytime i need to pull down the notification bar to check whether net is on or not.
  

  6. In call sound quality is average. It may be good. But i personally found it bad comapred to coolpad note 3 n all my previous phones. But i think u will not face any problem with it. It is ok.
  

  7. Even if it is small n handy, it is slightly thick n heavy. I usually love slim n lightweight phones. If u use a back cover with it then u will definitely feel the heft. Without cover it is gud.
  

  So this is all about this device. Can't confirm abt OTG. cuz i dnt have a otg cable. In marshmallow u can use ur sd card as internal storage so no problem of moving apps to sd.
  
  Cheers have a gud day!

  Pros: -
  
  1) Battery life upto 6-7 hrs.
  
  2) Ram user friendly.
  
  3) Massive storage of 16 gb (available 10 gb) is good in this price range.
  
  4) 5" display with gorrila glass.
  
  5) Handle normal graphics game very good.
  

  Cons: -
  
  1) Display quality not good. Display is yellowish . I use a software for make it white.
  
  2) Camera is poor. Front cam is bad and rear camera does not have autofocus. but it support full hd and slow-motion video recording.
  
  3) Launcher is full of ads and bloadwars. for smooth running and free space uninstall that and use nova launcher instead of main Launcher.
  

  Its my opinion about this device. I hope it will help you for make your decision. Thank you.

column6: Good Phone with great specs in less price.
column7:
I am using this phone for over 10 days from now. Overall, it is really a great buy in this price range. The performance is great with decent battery backup on average usage.
  
  I tried almost all high end games like Real Racing 3, GT Racing 2, Mortal Combat. Frontline Commando 2, Fifa 15.. no lag whatsoever. GPS locking is superfast in 2-5 seconds.IPS Screen is really with Oleo-phobic coating to be smudge-proof and scratch-resistant. Colors are vibrant with nice display. Camera is satisfactory with HD video recording.
  
  Apart from these positives, this phone has few negatives too;
  

  Though the RAM is 2GB but even after rooting and using RAM Manager, I am getting 1GB free RAM hardly at any point of time but no lags while multitasking and playing games due to efficient Octacore Processor.
  

  I feel the SD Card expansion is of no use as you cannot move apps to SD Cards. Also, in Storage settings, you have the options of Default Write Disk between Phone Storage and SD Card but even if you select SD Card, your App Data or Game Data will save in Phone Storage. No complain here, because, for me 16GB(usable 12GB) is enough for me.
  

  The worst problem I felt was HEATING. While playing games or even on call for more than 10-15 mins, phone starts to heat near Camera, probably Processor is located there. The heat is not very significant but you can very well feel it. Good thing is that it cools down very significantly.
  

  Every device have their PROs and CONs but with this price I will recommend this device.

Pros:
  
  1.Very good display.Very vibrant display.
  
  2.Back panel looks too good and feels great.
  
  3.There is no lag.
  
  4.No problem with multitasking.
  
  5.Internet connection great.
  
  6.Front camera is superb.
  
  7.Battery is great(Tell you later why)
  
  8.Very light inspite of 2500 mah battery.
  
  9.Rear camera very good at outdoors.
  
  10.Call quality good and call reception also nice.
  
  11.Thin and slim.Easily operate by one hand.
  
  12.Nice earphone.
  
  13.Video playback good.
  

  Cons:
  

  1.No otg support.
  
  2.Takes long(3hours) to charge from zero to 100%.
  
  3.Rear camera not good in low light.
  
  4.No gorilla glass.
  



  Battery issue solved:
  
  Actually the battery of this phone is not calibrated.
  
  Steps to calibrate:
  
  1.At first use,run the phone untill the phone discharge fully.
  
  2.Switch off and charge.Charge one or two hours more than after It shows 100%
  
  3.Switch on the phone.
  
  4.Switch on all power consuming things like wifi,bluetooth,location and use the phone continuously till it becomes dead.
  
  5.Again follow from step 2 to step 4 for atleast 3 cycles of full charge and discharge.
  
  6.Battery will be calibrated.
  
  7.Then dont turn on power consuming things all the time.Use normally as desired.
  


  Battery easily go for 1.5 days for moderate use and to 2 days for less use.

column6: A311 A premium looking cheap phone
column7:
I was using a CANVAS HD A116 for last 1.5 Years. So decided to change it all of a sudden. So ordered it on Sunday, got it today. After usage of 6 Hours here are my thoughts -
  
  "The Ugly" -
  
  - No compass. Again this phone doesn't show which way I am going. The existing AGPS is very poor. Will have to root the phone and add the india AGPS library myself. (Lesson from Canvas HD)
  
  - The lowest Brightness is extremely low, and when you move the slider, it becomes too much bright. Its just not balanced. Will need to find a workaround to adjust it by value.
  
  - Flash is poor. Having said that the existing app is not the end of the world. I was using snap camera and will continue to use it on this phone. That should produce better results. (Lesson from Canvas HD)
  
  - Under the back cover, there is a white strip, which I have no idea why its there. It absolutely makes no sense what-so-ever. Also it is not installed properly at all.
  
  - No flip cover provided, unlike Canvas HD which came with a flip cover (Though bought is from a retailer, not online).
  
  - The Headphones are rubbish. I really don't understand why they provide any. instead they could have a givena class 10 memory card or reduce the price by 700 bucks by remoing the headphones. will be a big improvement.
  
  - Too much useless junk app. Who in their right mind would use opera mini in android. Also is giving problem with dolphin browser. Again the limitation of installed app space. That also I have to increase. (Lesson from Canvas HD)
  
  - Battery indicator is completely un-calibrated. I believe when they calibrated, they did that with a test inferior battery of lesser power MAh. Need to find a way to calibrate the battery indicator on my own. (Lesson from Canvas HD)
  
  - The heating issue is prominant with heavy games. And unlike canvas HD, it is too slik, hence damage chances are much greater. Need to find workaround for that too.
  

  "The Bad"
  
  - Phone by default runs on CPU power saver mode. remove that check box and the phone then really becomes alive. worth every penny from sped and fluidity point of view.
  
  - First and foremost, remove the check box from Bus Audio enhancement and loudness enhancement. Then the sound quality becomes really good. But I canot yet write awesome, since I am still waiting for a skullcandy.
  
  - Root the phone, Period.
  
  - The recetion of FM is odd. But since that depends on location and length and quality of headphones, further investigation required on this part. But when catches good reception, the sound quality is good.
  
  - Speaker sound is low. (As expected)
  
  - The Charger head is very small and not good quality. Although the charger cable is good. One fun fact, in India we suffer from fluctuation in the power lines (I am Elec. engg.) and most of us don't know that our house earthing is no good at all. Also those who travel in trains (apart from shatabdi, rajdhani, and duronto) all the train plug point meant for charger are Short circuit and charging your phone in that means your gonna have problems in the long run. In order to test the line, put the phone in charging, then go to the locking option and select screen pattern. Then try to draw the pattern, you'll get the idea if the line is Short circuit or not. Try to buy a sony ericson charger, which has a capacitor like thing integrated in the charger chord. Will save you from a lot of harm.
  
  - UI is Ripoff from Sony mobiles which I don't like. (Personal view)
  
  - In call volume is low.
  

  "The Good" (Of-course it has some good points, the very reason I bought it.)
  
  - The unbeatable price. Really no argument there.
  
  - The camera is nice, and I mean really nice. Try snapping pics with a third party app like snap camera. Video is also decent.
  
  - Browsing is fast. Cell reception is good. Wi-Fi is having some problems, but its working.
  
  - The inbuilt memory is 16 GB, so more or less 11+ GB is usable. Also you can move apps to SD card (Yuppppee).
  
  - Scrennguard provided for free with the phone.
  
  - Android Kit Kat 4.4.2, which is not latest but good.
  
  - Small, and premium look. The design is really good.
  
  - IF you know how to use ti properly, and root it to get rid of the pre installed app, and run it on CPU saver mode, then the battery drain will be low. It can easily go on for about 2 days. (Thanks to a lower 720p screen, which I always appreciate, since it helps to reduce power consumption and a 5 inch screen has no need for 1080p resolution. BTW it can play 1080p videos with again third party app.)
  
  - IPS display. The display is the main feature. The black depths are great. Though PPI is still under 300, its decent display. Viewing angles are also wide.
  
  Final words - I am ready to overlook everything, but I just miss one thing. Why not a compass ? Why not a compass ? Why not a compass ? If only it had a compass. :( :( :( :( :( :( :( all gionee and cheap china phones have compass, why not MMX.. what's wrong with them... fools.....

I have both MOTO G 2nd Gen and bought A311 for my father as e doesn't like MOTO G. He is an average user with whatsapp, skype, calls, emails and texts in the day and is not into gaming. What is even more astonishing is the superb battery life (especially when the phone is idle, the battery drops by MAX 1% through the night! whereas my moto g loses 6-7%)
  

  I replicated my moto g on to nitro and foung Nitro's performance to be better (smoothness, temperature, battery backup)

  The faux leather back is very nice to feel and gives a good grip
  

  Screen is glass but NOT gorilla glass. MMX mentioned oleophobic coating but it oesn't work and you do get fingerprints.
  

  Battery is 2500 mah and is superb. Mobile will easily last 2 full days of normal use
  

  Internal memory is bumped to 16GB an can be expanded 32 GB more via micro sd card
  

  Phone is very light and has good grip
  

  Audio output is ok, could have been better (Moto G is way ahead)
  

  No heating or lagging issues. 800 MB RAM free at first boot (On running usual applications at once the available RAM drops ro 200-250 mb, but there is cleanmaster pre iinstalled, use the widget and boom! RAM boosted to 400-500 MB)
  

  Camera is good. Front is fixed focus but takes decent pictures. Color reproduction is good.
  

  Only Sim 1 is 3G. Sim 2 is 2G
  

  Bundled headphones are nice. Overall quality of accessories has improved a lot.
  

  In a nutshell, this is the best micromax phone available in the range 9000-14000 (not counting Yu series phones).

column6: Amazing Specs on paper but performance says otherwise... :(
column7:
My experience with this phone has been below average. I purchased it from Flipkart approximately in June 2015, and finally exchanged it for a Redmi 2 Prime instead which is far better than this one.
  

  My Observations:
  
  -> 1.7 Octoacore processor is expected to give you a smooth experience for atleast your day to day work. But evn normal apps opeining and screen transition were laggy.
  

  -> The phone reboots abruptly, and at situation when you need to get work done fast like, booking a tatkal ticket, or making a bank transaction, a reboot is the last thing you want.
  

  -> Battery is horrible: In 2500 mAh I dont expect 24 hours with this kind of specs, but atleast give me 18-20 hours on normal usage. I done play games. My major usage involve, casual surfing, calls, whatsapp, facebook etc. But you know whats the average battery backup??? -----> > > Its 8 hours to 11 hours. I have 100% charge while leaving for office, and by the time I come back my phone is dead!! You need to have a power bank with you always. But power banks also damage the battery.
  

  -> The Multitasking capacitive button has a probability of 70%. Meaning 30% of the time you tap on it, you wont see the exisiting running apps shows up. This is irritating when you want to switch between apps and the phone is having fun with you :P
  

  Btw the phone is not all about cons:
  
  -> Rear Camera is Good. Not above average, but Good.
  
  -> The video playback in really smooth. As in its got a high Refresh rate which makes watching any video a pleasant experience.
  

  Apart from that all other features were as usual.
  

  But here comes the catch. My friend has the exact same model, and his phone is working just fine, other than the battery which is quite the same for him too. As a matter of fact I purchased this phone after checking his phone, but I am selling it off now.
  

  So the verdict is Micromax cant be trusted on the quality front. The same phone can be good for someone and may be bad for someone else.
  

  I hope this helps.
  

  Cheers

The following review is NOT small. It is sufficiently detailed so that one can get an idea how the device performs.
  

  I have been using this phone's preceder the Micromax Canvas Nitro A310 for the past 6 months. (I bought it within one month of launch). Phone is not Micromax's flagship, still as per the specs and price of course back then, it's a beast.
  
  Lollipop update, fingers crossed. Most likely to come. There's barely any chance that the update won't come. I mean, come on man,  micromax unite 2 has got it. XD
  

  Summarizing the specs.
  

  Cons first:
  

  1. Overheats while charging and playing games like Asphalt 8 and FIFA. Cure is, download any booster. When you stop playing the game. Clean the memory.  Finished, it cools down at a rapid pace. (CM included as boltware.)
  

  2. Boltware (problem with all micromax) and unused Google apps. Disable them. No problem again.
  

  3. Low light performance of camera. Like most of the phone's cameras, the sensor struggles to let the light come inside the sensor. And if you think flash would make a difference. The metering actually smashes the quality. Poorly exposed low light results. Google camera fixes it up pretty much. Still it can do much better. The metering could and should be fixed by the means of software.
  

  4. Battery percentage alignment was not proper. Which was later fixed my micromax. Should be already fixed in A311.
  

  Pros :
  

  1. Screen 10/10. Crisp, the blackening when screen is off and ofcourse the auto brightness performance of phone in sunlight and other places, amazing. 720p for 5" is crisp. No need to spend extra battery on more pixels.
  

  2. Feel and Build: Well built and sturdy. This phone actually fell many times. Still it works like a new one. Even I almost threw it at a pace of a cricket ball once, and it hit the wall. Thankfully nothing happened. Looks classy. Feels premium. Though plastic material.
  

  3. Processor and GPU : 9/10. Multitasking is buttery smooth.  (thanks to the 2Gigs RAM though) . I actually have beasts like asphalt 8 installed. The phone heats up a bit but performance is amazing. Apparently no frame loss on highest settings.
  

  4. Camera
  
  Day and Consider light in a room : 10/10
  
  Low/Very Low Light : 5/10
  

  You won't regret buying this phone if you're looking for a camera phone. Monuments, close ups, scenery, of course the selfies etc. come out real sweet. I'd recommend using Google Camera or Camera 360.
  

  5. Battery 8/10 :  Without data on 1 complete day. Including gaming and videos. Data pack on, and the battery craves to get out. falls in 4-5hours. Bit annoying but managable.
  




  Overall, this is truly a beast. Moto G2, my friend got it. It doesn't have anything more fascinating except for Lollipop. But no worries, we'll get it soon. If you're thinking of something under 10k. Go for this or the Yureka.Yureka would be better in software but hardware is a bit behind. Redmi 2s would be another attention seeker though. If you're planning to buy something from 10-15k bracket. Dude, wait for thd Asus Zenphone 2. And add 2-3k to budget. Zenfone 2 is an economical beast. Your addition of 2-3k will be very fruitful. Expected launch of Zenfone 2 on flipkart 23rd April.

First of all, I need to thank Flipkart and BlueDart for fast delivery. I booked it on 4th October at night, and got it on 7th morning, though the due date was 14th. Moreover, I got this for only Rs. 4679. The packaging was good.  I bought it for a friend, and he has been using it for last few days with satisfaction. It has not given any trouble so far. However, the phone has some drawbacks. Let me put my thought into words.
  

  1. Looks: The phn looks classy and premium with its blue slightly curved back panel. Because of the curved back the phn appears to be slimmer. Rating 10/10
  

  2. Screen: The screen is really vibrant for its price range, however, I did not like the icons. Good viewing angles. Rating 9/10
  

  3. Storage: At this price segment you are getting 2gb of RAM and 16gb of internal memory, that is really great. However, phn is full of bloatware. The unnecessary apps will irritate you because most of them can not be uninstalled. So usable memory is around 11gb. Rating 8/10
  

  4. Performance: The phn has 2gb of RAM and Cortex-A53 Mediatek MT6735P Processor, but the phn is not as fast as I expected. It takes time to load apps, if you are using multiple apps at the same time, the phn starts lagging. 7/10
  

  5. Camera: 8MP primary camera with flash and 2MP front camera sounds good, but camera performance is not so good. The phn captures RED and GREEN colour very well and the colours look vibrant. However, other colours appear a bit dull. I must say, primary camera is ok type. Front camera is not at all fit for taking selfies. Rating 7/10
  

  6. Battery: Battery should be the main reason for not buying this phn. The phn has a 2000mph battery but it does not seem so. Battery drains really fast and if you are a regular user, you need to charge the phn at least 3 times in 2 days. And if you are a heavy user and watch videos or play games or browse internet a lot, you need to charge it 2 to 3 times everyday. Then again it takes around 2 hours to get fully charged. I am really disappointed with the performance of the battery. 5/10
  

  7. Sound: Sound quality is not so good. The speaker is on the back and does not provide good quality sound. The earpiece on the top is not good as well. You have to press the phn hard against your ear to listen to the other person while making calls. Call quality is not good as well. 7/10
  

  8. Other Features: The sensors are good. The proximity sensor is working fine. But, I am disappointed with the performance of the light sensor. It does not change the brightness of the screen properly and often you have to intervene to change the brightness of the screen. 8.5/10
  

  My final final verdict is 3.5*. However, if I would have to spend 6K (the phn's current price), I would not buy this phn. Luckily we got it at only 4.7K and we are quite happy with it.

column6: Not extraordinary but very decent..4.7 stars out of 5 .
column7:
I received this from flipkart the day before yesterday. The phone fulfills my expectation to quite extent. My priority was not high, as I used this for miscellaneous usage, as I have two other smartphones which are is used in more important purposes. Here are the Pros and Cons that I noticed after using it for two days.
  
  Pros:
  
  1) Damn slim, looks good in hand, very lightweight even after applying additional back cover.
  
  2) Quite fast in operation as expected from a octacore processor phone,switching between apps is smooth. Contact list opens fast, unlike few of the users have complained that it takes ages to load contact list.
  
  3) It hasn't hanged for a single time till now neither it heated up after continuously using it for say 1 hour or so.
  
  4) Exactly 11.23 GB user usable phone memory for app storage, which is HUGE for a normal and sane user.
  
  5) Last but not the least, and most surprising and most important for a micromax smartphone. I charged the phone whole night on 18th March, then used in say 10 hours or so in total. But the battery percentage is showing 72% as of now when I am writing this review !!!!! That's WOW for me, as this is coming from a micromax device.
  
  CONS:
  
  1) Not for heavy gaming for sure.
  
  2) Like other users have commented, camera quality is not awesome but very decent according to me.
  
  3) The back key, home key etc. are on the screen itself, which makes the 5 inch display small.
  
  4) Two apps, Google play store ans Google tray (which contains all google products) can not be removed from home screen at any cost. So you can't keep your home screen absolutely clean.
  
  5) Apps can not be placed in alphabetical order.
  
  Overall assessment:
  
  Very decent phone. But don't buy it if you are impressed with the 13 MP back camera and you are into heavy gaming. And if you are buying this go for this particular gold and white model rather the black and grey one. It's looks very good and sophisticated in hand.
  

  Good Luck to all the prospective buyers.
  
  I hope this phone will not make me change my review after some more days ;-)
  
  PS- This is a genuine review. Still it's up to you whether to take it or leave it.

column6: After Using it for about 2 Months
column7:
Purchased this mobile because previously I had a good experience with Micromax (With Micromax Unite 2 A106, until it got stolen).
  
  I bought this phone merely on the basis of its specification (13MP camera, Octacore processor, etc)
  
  A few important points to consider :
  
  1. The battery life is okay when it is fully charged. As soon as it hits 20% it starts to drain out very quickly.
  
  2. The camera quality is okayish. The photographs clicked with this camera look like 5MP rather than 13MP. My mother's Lumia 730 clicks better & clearer photographs even in selfie mode. Camera settings options seem primitive. If you plan to buy it on basis of its cam, then please dont.
  
  3. For some unfortunate reason, my date and time are again and again reset to a certain time in future, due to which I have missed plenty of morning alarms, reminders as well as notifications.
  
  4. The user interface is actually a MIUI (developed by Xiomi, I think). I did not like this interface. There is no separate apps tray, everything stays on home screen. although you can group them.
  
  5. There is NO update to Lollipop (Android 5.0)
  
  6. Get real, its a budget phone. Its not meant for heavy gaming (heats up). (Temple Run, Candy Crush run okay, dont know about others)
  
  7. It also heats up while charging and after using 3g internet for about 2hrs or wifi. Do not use it while charging.
  
  8. It consists of some pre-installed apps like doctor security. The phone does not allow you to uninstall or disable them and the app keeps asking you to update it. If you try to update, it says "Please uninstall the previous version & then try again". Its an infinite loop. Had to use an external app to uninstall it.
  
  9. Ample space, you can use a huge amount of apps.
  
  10. Getting the provided specifications in the given budget is an asset, although some of the provided features are only on papers.
  
  11. Good Appearance
  
  12. The box contains a screen guard too. Quality of earphones is 'micromax'. Just average plugs.
  

  It is an average budget phone with good built quality and average performance. Its not great, but not bad either.

column6: Not extraordinary but very decent..4.7 stars out of 5 .
column7:
I received this from flipkart the day before yesterday. The phone fulfills my expectation to quite extent. My priority was not high, as I used this for miscellaneous usage, as I have two other smartphones which are is used in more important purposes. Here are the Pros and Cons that I noticed after using it for two days.
  
  Pros:
  
  1) Damn slim, looks good in hand, very lightweight even after applying additional back cover.
  
  2) Quite fast in operation as expected from a octacore processor phone,switching between apps is smooth. Contact list opens fast, unlike few of the users have complained that it takes ages to load contact list.
  
  3) It hasn't hanged for a single time till now neither it heated up after continuously using it for say 1 hour or so.
  
  4) Exactly 11.23 GB user usable phone memory for app storage, which is HUGE for a normal and sane user.
  
  5) Last but not the least, and most surprising and most important for a micromax smartphone. I charged the phone whole night on 18th March, then used in say 10 hours or so in total. But the battery percentage is showing 72% as of now when I am writing this review !!!!! That's WOW for me, as this is coming from a micromax device.
  
  CONS:
  
  1) Not for heavy gaming for sure.
  
  2) Like other users have commented, camera quality is not awesome but very decent according to me.
  
  3) The back key, home key etc. are on the screen itself, which makes the 5 inch display small.
  
  4) Two apps, Google play store ans Google tray (which contains all google products) can not be removed from home screen at any cost. So you can't keep your home screen absolutely clean.
  
  5) Apps can not be placed in alphabetical order.
  
  Overall assessment:
  
  Very decent phone. But don't buy it if you are impressed with the 13 MP back camera and you are into heavy gaming. And if you are buying this go for this particular gold and white model rather the black and grey one. It's looks very good and sophisticated in hand.
  

  Good Luck to all the prospective buyers.
  
  I hope this phone will not make me change my review after some more days ;-)
  
  PS- This is a genuine review. Still it's up to you whether to take it or leave it.

column6: Definitely The Best Phone At This Price Range.
column7:
Review After 2 Months Of Use.
  

  BUILD QUALITY-
  
  The phone feels solid to hold.The back cover is of matte finish.The phone has a premium look.
  

  DISPLAY-
  
  Display doesn't seem to be pixelated if user is not holding the phone too close.The colors are vivid and display is bright.Watching movies in this display is great.
  

  CAMERA-
  
  Overall the camera performance is average.Macro shots looks pretty good and detailed compared to distant shots.Colour reproduction of camera is not good.Colour appears to be washed away.
  

  PERFORMANCE-
  
  The Phone is a solid performer.Apps open up quickly.There is no lag.Due to 1GB of RAM phone handles multitasking with ease.Some HD games have slight lag,but during the gameplay user won't notice it.
  

  STORAGE-
  
  Internal Storage is 1.27 GB which is for apps .Phone Storage is704 MB.Apps is not movable to SD card.Although you can move some of the games that is stored in Phone storage to Internal storage.
  

  OTHER-
  
  Battery sometimes gives excellent backup,sometimes it give normal backup like all android phones.Touch responsive is not excellent but good for this price point.Camera flash is bright.Phone doesn't heat up much.
  

  BOX CONTENT-
  
  It comes with a free screen guard and micro fiber cloth for wiping the screen.The screen guard quality is not good,it gets scratched easily.Better to use other screen guard.Earphone quality is average,it has no bass.But the quality of sound it delivers is pretty good.
  

  VERDICT-
  
  It is one of the best phone at this price.But now new Micromax Canvas UNITE 2 outperforms Canvas JUICE.But both are a sold performer.If you want better battery you should go for JUICE.If you want a bit more performance you should go for UNITE 2.

column6: great 5" tablet (read on to understand what I mean)
column7:
This is the 3rd, 4th or 5th MMX product I bought.
  

  For a long time I have known and realized that MMX has the worst antennas ... if they have them at all. I mean, even the cheapest little phone from Korea will pick up a 3G signal, but an MMX phone refuses to pick up any signal if you are not within 100 steps of the tower.
  

  When I got this phone, I was thrilled to see this "giant" phone. Size wise it easily compares to some of the popular, but significantly costlier, Korean brands. Features wise too it didn't seem bad. But antenna wise ... that's a different story!
  

  Happy to have received an "Indian" product that cost almost 1/3 the price of an equivalent Korean "grand" product, I quickly pulled out the SIMs from a "grand" phone I had and put them into this. But then it hit me: antenna wise this is still an "MMX" product! :)
  

  There's a docomo tower 3 lanes away from my house. And this darn thing wouldn't pick up the 3G signal. There's an airtel tower in FRONT of my house and this darn thing wouldn't pick up that 3G signal either!!
  

  Worse, people started complaining that I was never reachable! After a lot of digging around, which involved RF engineers from the telcos, we ultimately homed onto this little culprit.
  

  Oh! BTW, only one sim-slot supports 3G. The other is a 2G slot. :)
  

  Bottomline: this is a pathetic phone.
  

  BUT ... and this is big ... this is a great little "tablet". I have (and had) multiple tablets in the 7", 8" and 10" form factors. Most of those tablets are not really easy to "handle". They are either too big or too heavy. Or they are just "like everyone else's tablet". But, this ... this MMX Canvas Juice A177 ... this little thing makes a great tablet. It is only 5.5 inches. It is easily pocketable. And it has a decent camera with flash. Just make sure you stand/sit/sleep within 10 feet of your wifi signal. :)
  

  Oh! Did I mention that rooting this thing was a piece of cake? I have one word for you: FramaRoot. I know you are thanking me for that.
  

  In conclusion: This is a horrible phone but a great little tablet. I wish they make more of these "tablets" at even cheaper prices.

My mother got the phone on 20th though the phone was in the town since 19th morning (5 a.m.) and it wasn't holiday that day. Now, my mother called me up when I was outside home and asked why she got stones inside phone box and no phone. I was shocked to learn that. All I could do was to complain Flipkart who asked me to wait for the resolve. I am awaiting for it. However, I would put a point that this was probably fullstop for me for shopping from Flipkart. And the seller, if I don't get refund, will be suited for sure.
  

  Be careful and always opt for cash on delivery. There is hardly any 200 gms of marble stone which is worth above 5000.
